This paper studies payoff-based higher-order variants of RD represented as a cascade interconnection between an integrator in parallel with an auxiliary linear time-invariant (LTI) system and the softmax mapping. We investigate learnability of Nash equilibria under this Nash-stationary learning rule. First, we revisit recent results that establish convergence to Nash Equilibrium whenever the auxiliary LTI system is strictly passive and prove a converse passivity result: if the auxiliary LTI system is not passive, then there exists a static strictly contractive game whose interior Nash equilibrium is unstable under the closed-loop learning dynamics. Second, we show that there exists a class of games with isolated interior Nash equilibria that cannot be locally asymptotically stabilized by any payoff-based higher-order RD whose auxiliary LTI system is asymptotically stable and strictly proper. Finally, we show that if Nash stationarity (i.e., all Nash equilibria are stationary points of the learning dynamics) is relaxed, then generalized exponential RD (Ex-RD) can locally asymptotically stabilize a logit equilibrium for any continuously differentiable game. The stabilized equilibrium can be viewed as an entropy-regularized approximate Nash equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于收益的高阶复制动态（RD）的学习规则，分析了其纳什均衡的可学习性，并提出了关于被动性、稳定性限制以及广义指数RD稳定性的新结果。
AI.motivation: 复制动态是博弈论中学习的基础模型，但传统RD可能无法处理所有博弈情况。作者希望探索高阶变体（通过级联LTI系统和softmax映射）是否能更好地学习纳什均衡，并理解其局限性。
AI.method: 通过系统理论分析，研究级联集成器、LTI系统和softmax映射构成的闭环学习动态。利用被动性理论、不动点分析和稳定性判据，分别讨论严格被动情形、非被动情形、以及放松纳什平稳性后的广义指数RD。
AI.result: 1. 严格被动LTI系统保证收敛到纳什均衡，且非被动系统存在静态严格收缩博弈使内点纳什均衡不稳定。2. 存在一类具有孤立内点纳什均衡的博弈，无法通过任何基于收益的高阶RD（LTI系统渐近稳定且严格真）实现局部渐近稳定。3. 放松纳什平稳性后，广义指数RD可局部渐近稳定任意连续可微博弈的logit均衡，该均衡可视为熵正则化的近似纳什均衡。
AI.conclusion: 高阶RD的被动性对纳什均衡的收敛至关重要，存在不可稳定化的博弈类别，但通过放松纳什平稳性，广义指数RD提供了更广泛的稳定化能力，可实现近似纳什均衡。

title: From Continuous Design to Delay-Aware Discrete Synthesis: Guaranteed High-Bandwidth Joint Control for PMSM Drives
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures
summary: The increasing dynamic demands of modern robotic joints require current controllers to achieve high bandwidth over wide operating ranges of speed, acceleration, and torque, where communication, computation, and discrete-time effects can no longer be neglected. Conventional PMSM current controllers are typically designed in continuous time and subsequently discretized, leaving the sampling frequency and the impact of implementation delays largely to heuristic selection and iterative validation. This paper introduces a task-aware, delay-extended discrete-time joint model that explicitly accounts for physical communication and computation delays and enables direct synthesis of a discrete PI current controller with prescribed bandwidth and delay guarantees throughout the operating envelope. The framework analytically determines the minimum required sampling frequency, controller gains, and DC-link voltage needed to satisfy the specified motor and joint performance. Simulations across a range of dynamic requirements validate the methodology and demonstrate substantially reduced sampling-frequency and DC-link-voltage requirements compared with conventional continuous-time-based design. Experiments on a newly developed custom robotic joint further validate the proposed framework under real embedded implementation conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种任务感知的、考虑通信与计算延迟的离散时间关节模型，用于直接综合具有指定带宽和延迟保证的离散PI电流控制器，并通过仿真和实验验证了该方法能显著降低采样频率和直流母线电压需求。
AI.motivation: 现代机器人关节的动态需求日益提高，传统连续时间设计的电流控制器在离散化后，采样频率和实现延迟的影响通常依赖启发式选择和迭代验证，缺乏系统性的分析方法。
AI.method: 建立了延迟扩展的离散时间关节模型，显式建模物理通信和计算延迟，基于该模型直接综合离散PI控制器，并解析确定最小采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压以满足性能要求。
AI.result: 仿真表明，与基于连续时间设计的传统方法相比，该方法显著降低了采样频率和直流母线电压需求；在自制机器人关节上的实验进一步验证了该框架在真实嵌入式实现条件下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为机器人关节电流控制器设计提供了系统性方法，能在保证带宽和延迟要求的同时降低硬件需求，具有实际应用价值。

title: Position: Evaluations of AI Moral Reasoning Still Miss Half of the Picture
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for archival publication at the ACL 2026 Workshop on Evaluating Evaluations (EvalEval)
summary: Recent work on evaluating the moral competence of large language models (LLMs) has focused primarily on what we call the moral value problem, i.e., whether model outputs align with human moral values. In contrast, the moral norm problem, i.e., whether models can identify and correctly apply context-sensitive moral norms, remains underexplored. We posit that this imbalance stems from the field's reliance on descriptive ethics frameworks, such as Moral Foundations Theory and Kohlberg's stages of moral development, which emphasize value representation over normative application. We review existing benchmarks and evaluation methods, and show that they cluster heavily around the value problem, while discussion regarding normative ethics remains underrepresented. We identify three crucial gaps: (i) the absence of high-quality ground-truth data for moral norms and their applications, (ii) insufficient evaluation of intermediate reasoning processes, and (iii) limited attention to the identification of morally relevant features in context. Subsequently, we propose a research agenda that includes the development of standardized formal representations for normative theories, the construction of expert-annotated datasets capturing norm application, and evaluation protocols that explicitly distinguish between values-level and norms-level competence. Our goal is to encourage a more systematic study of normative reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前大语言模型道德评估过度关注价值对齐，而忽视了情境化道德规范的识别与应用，并提出了针对规范推理的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要依赖描述性伦理框架（如道德基础理论），集中于价值问题，导致道德规范问题（如情境化规范的识别与应用）被忽视，作者希望推动更系统的规范推理研究。
AI.method: 通过综述现有基准和评估方法，分析其分布偏差，识别三个关键缺口，并提出包括标准化规范表示、专家标注数据集和区分价值/规范评估协议的研究议程。
AI.result: 发现基准和方法过度集中于价值问题，规范伦理讨论不足，且存在数据、推理过程和特征识别三个缺口。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁社区关注LLM的规范推理能力，并采用更严谨的评估方法以平衡价值与规范层面的道德能力研究。

title: Path2ST: Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Grounded Cross-Modal Translation for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E)-stained images offers a cost-effective alternative to spatial transcriptomics (ST). However, existing methods treat H\&E images as generic visual inputs and ignore their intrinsic biological hierarchy, where spatially organized cell types collectively form functional tissue microenvironments that govern local gene expression programs. To bridge this gap, we formulate H\&E-to-ST prediction as a cross-modal semantic translation task and propose Path2ST, a hierarchically grounded autoregressive framework featuring three key components: (i) a Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning mechanism that fuses explicit and implicit cellular features with tissue-level semantic representations to construct hierarchical conditioning signals; (ii) a Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation process over a hierarchical semantic vocabulary, enabling coarse-to-fine, biologically consistent expression synthesis; and (iii) SpectraLoss, a full-spectrum objective that jointly enforces ordinal fidelity, models transcriptional bursts, and aligns semantic structures with cell types. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating that Path2ST generates highly accurate and spatially coherent transcriptomic profiles. The related code is released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/Path2ST.

AI.tldr: 提出Path2ST框架，将H&E到空间转录组的预测建模为跨模态语义翻译任务，通过层次化细胞-组织条件机制、尺度自适应自回归生成和全谱损失函数，实现高精度且空间连贯的基因表达预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将H&E图像视为通用视觉输入，忽略了其固有的生物学层次结构，即空间组织的细胞类型共同形成功能性的组织微环境，从而决定局部基因表达程序。
AI.method: Path2ST包含三个关键组件：层次化细胞-组织条件机制融合显式和隐式细胞特征与组织级语义表示；基于层次语义词汇的尺度自适应自回归生成过程实现从粗到细的表达合成；全谱目标SpectraLoss联合优化序数保真、转录爆发建模和语义结构与细胞类型对齐。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的广泛实验表明，Path2ST达到了最先进的性能，生成高度准确且空间连贯的转录组谱。
AI.conclusion: 验证了Path2ST通过利用生物学层次结构，能够有效提升H&E图像到空间基因表达预测的准确性和生物学一致性。

title: Inference-Time Mitigation of Adversarial Political Bias in Large Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become the mainstay for information retrieval and summarization tasks, ensuring that they are always non-partisan and invulnerable to political bias is a critical step towards safer and more trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (AI). Current model alignment paradigms, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), make LLMs follow overarching safety instructions. However, this instruction tuning can be exploited via adversarial prompt injection and be used to generate unsafe content. In particular, political bias has not been specifically targeted by modern alignment techniques as harmful and biased content. To address this vulnerability of LLMs, we propose mitigation strategies using Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Using a public dataset of legislative videos, we generate summaries using LLMs, inject bias via adversarial prompting and evaluate their performance on a four axis scale designed for political summarization. In this paper, we present different methods to shield LLMs against the injection of political bias. Our results demonstrate that the proposed Recursive Self-Correction approach raises model performance from a Political Neutrality Likert scale baseline of 2.14 to 4.56, averaged across all models, demonstrating effective inference-time mitigation of political bias in LLM-generated summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在政治摘要生成中的偏见漏洞，提出基于思维链（CoT）提示和直接偏好优化（DPO）的缓解策略。其中，递归自我修正方法将政治中立性评分从2.14提升至4.56（满分5分），有效实现推理时去偏。
AI.motivation: LLM在信息检索和摘要任务中日益普及，但现有对齐技术（如RLHF）未专门针对政治偏见进行防护，且易受对抗性提示注入攻击，导致生成有偏见内容，威胁AI的安全性和可信度。
AI.method: 使用公开的立法视频数据集生成摘要，通过对抗性提示注入政治偏见，并在四轴量表上评估性能。提出多种缓解方法，包括思维链提示、直接偏好优化以及递归自我修正（Recursive Self-Correction）等。
AI.result: 递归自我修正方法在所有模型上将政治中立性Likert量表得分从2.14提升至4.56，平均表现最佳，有效缓解了推理时的政治偏见。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的推理时缓解策略（尤其是递归自我修正）能显著增强LLM对政治偏见注入的抵抗力，为构建更安全、公正的AI系统提供了可行方案。

title: Deep learning-based computed tomography (CT) derived body composition classifier for colorectal cancer patients
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures
summary:
Background: Accurate body composition analysis using Computed Tomography (CT) scans is essential for assessing skeletal muscle area (SMA) and skeletal muscle density (SMD), key markers of nutritional status in cancer patients. Conventional manual methods are labour-intensive and require specialist expertise, limiting their routine clinical use. Therefore, this study serves as a feasibility and pilot investigation to explore the potential of deep learning-based automated regression for body composition analysis within a clinical workflow.
  Methods: Four deep learning architectures (AlexNet, UNet, GoogLeNet, and ResNet34) were trained to predict SMA, SMD, subcutaneous fat area (SFA), and visceral fat area (VFA) from CT scans of colorectal cancer patients. Systematic hyperparameter optimization identified the most accurate models, which were subsequently implemented in a web application for clinical use.
  Results: GoogLeNet achieved the best performance, with a mean percentage error (PE) of 4.96% for SMA prediction, while AlexNet reached 8.12% for SMD. Independent testing demonstrated robust accuracy, correctly classifying body composition metrics in 80% of cases. The web application delivered rapid and consistent outputs, supporting integration into clinical workflows.
  Conclusion: Optimized deep learning models, particularly GoogLeNet and AlexNet, can automate CT-derived body composition analysis with a Mean Percentage Error (PE) of 4.96% for SMA and 8.12% for SMD. These tools have the potential to streamline clinical practice by reducing the time and expertise required for manual segmentation. Further validation in larger, more diverse datasets is warranted.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索了基于深度学习的自动化CT身体成分分析在结直肠癌患者中的可行性，GoogLeNet和AlexNet分别实现了SMA和SMD的最佳预测，表现出良好的准确性，并已集成到网络应用中。
AI.motivation: 传统的手动CT身体成分分析方法耗时且需要专业知识，限制了其常规临床应用，因此需要一种自动化、高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 研究采用四种深度学习架构（AlexNet、UNet、GoogLeNet和ResNet34）进行训练，预测SMA、SMD、SFA和VFA，并通过超参数优化选择最佳模型，最终将模型部署到网络应用中。
AI.result: GoogLeNet在SMA预测上达到最佳性能，平均百分比误差为4.96%，AlexNet在SMD预测上达到8.12%，独立测试中80%的案例分类正确。
AI.conclusion: 优化的深度学习模型（特别是GoogLeNet和AlexNet）能够以较低误差自动化CT身体成分分析，有望减少临床工作量和所需专业知识，但需在更大更多样化的数据集中进一步验证。

title: Ranking-Augmented On-Policy Optimization with Adaptive Advantage-Normalization for Constrained Control
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC). (c) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media. The full copyright notice appears on the first page of the paper
summary: This paper analyzes the boundedness and feasibility properties of Advantage-Ranked Group Relative Policy Optimization (A-GRPO), a ranking-augmented, critic-free policy gradient method employing a Transformer-encoder actor for fixed-horizon control with terminal constraints. When feasibility is evaluated only at the final step, the resulting sparse feedback destabilizes critic-based advantage estimation and weakens standard Lagrangian approaches. A trajectory-level ranking mechanism that augments group-relative policy updates by reweighting advantages according to constraint satisfaction is formalized, and three results are established: (i) a scale-adaptive per-timestep normalization bounds advantage variance at every timestep independently, (ii) the ranked advantage strictly separates feasible from violating trajectories under a verifiable ranking-weight condition, biasing the policy gradient toward constraint satisfaction, and (iii) the adaptive dual variables remain bounded and exhibit a drift-balance property that acts as a feedback mechanism for feasibility. These results are validated on a 3,605-step series-hybrid powertrain energy management task with a terminal state-of-charge constraint, where A-GRPO achieves 75.4% mean sustained feasibility with return within 3.7% of the dynamic programming optimum, outperforming a Proximal Policy Optimization with Lagrangian penalties (PPO-Lag) baseline (27.4% sustained), and ablation experiments confirm that both the ranking and Lagrangian components are necessary for this performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了A-GRPO算法，该算法在固定时域终端约束控制中结合了轨迹级排序机制，通过重新加权优势函数来偏向可行轨迹，并证明了其优势方差有界、等级分离特性及对偶变量有界性。在超过3600步的混合动力能量管理任务中，A-GRPO达到了75.4%的持续可行性，且回报接近动态规划最优，显著优于PPO-Lag基准。
AI.motivation: 在固定时域终端约束控制中，仅在最终步骤评估可行性会导致稀疏反馈，从而破坏基于评论家的优势估计并削弱标准拉格朗日方法的效果。因此需要一种无评论家的策略梯度方法，能够有效处理终端约束并提升可行性。
AI.method: 提出A-GRPO，一种基于排序增强的无评论家策略梯度方法，采用Transformer编码器作为动作器。算法通过轨迹级排序机制，根据约束满足情况对组内相对策略更新的优势进行重新加权，并引入了尺度自适应的每时间步归一化、满足可验证排序权重条件的等级分离，以及自适应对偶变量。
AI.result: 在3605步的串联混合动力能量管理任务中，A-GRPO达到75.4%的平均持续可行性，回报与动态规划最优仅差3.7%，远超PPO-Lag基准（27.4%持续可行性）。消融实验表明排序和拉格朗日模块均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: A-GRPO通过排序增强和自适应对偶变量有效解决了稀疏反馈问题，在终端约束控制任务中显著优于传统拉格朗日方法，展示了其在长时域控制中的潜力。

title: Model-Free Based Computations of Recursive Control Barrier Function: Ultra-Local Model Approach
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures, submitted to Systems & Control Letters
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a systematic framework for enforcing safety constraints in nonlinear control systems. However, their implementation typically relies on accurate system models, which can limit their applicability in the presence of significant modeling uncertainties or unknown dynamics. This paper proposes a model-free framework for the computation of recursive control barrier functions based on the ultra-local model approach that leverages online estimation of the unknown system dynamics to construct CBF constraints. This approach does not require an explicit model of the system dynamics and enhances robustness with respect to disturbances and model mismatch. The resulting control architecture enables the enforcement as well as the anticipation of safety constraints for systems with higher relative degree. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is illustrated on the adaptive cruise control benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于超局部模型的无模型控制障碍函数框架，通过在线估计未知动态来构造CBF约束，无需显式系统模型，增强了对扰动和模型失配的鲁棒性，并在自适应巡航控制基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统控制障碍函数依赖精确系统模型，在存在显著建模不确定性或未知动态时应用受限。
AI.method: 采用超局部模型方法在线估计未知系统动态，并基于估计构造递归控制障碍函数约束，无需显式模型。
AI.result: 在自适应巡航控制基准上验证了该方法能有效执行和预测高阶相对度的安全约束，且对扰动和模型失配具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的无模型CBF框架在不确定动态下能有效保障安全，扩展了CBF的适用性。

title: From Doyle to AGM: A Survey and an Implementation Roadmap for Belief Change
comment: Author's accepted manuscript of an article published in The European Journal on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (SAGE). 65 pages, 2 figures. Final published version available at https://doi.org/10.1177/30504554261426170
summary: This paper presents a targeted narrative review establishing the historical and theoretical foundations for computational belief change implementation. Seeded by Doyle and London's foundational 1980 taxonomy, we trace the evolution of belief revision from computational origins through the theoretical transformation of the AGM framework to contemporary approaches. Our analysis demonstrates how pre-AGM computational pragmatism relates to AGM theoretical constructs, revealing both continuities and transformations across this evolution. We analyze how each taxonomical category evolved in the post-AGM era, identifying the theoretical foundations and historical precedents that inform contemporary implementation challenges. This foundation enables subsequent research into robust computational blueprints that synthesize historical insights with formal guarantees, providing the baseline for systematic implementation analysis and engineering-focused belief change research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过叙述性综述，追溯了信念修正从计算起源到AGM理论框架再到当代方法的演变，揭示了前AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论构造之间的连续性与转变，为后续工程化信念变更研究奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立计算信念变更实现的历史与理论基础，解决当前实现挑战中缺乏系统历史视角的问题。
AI.method: 以Doyle和London的1980年分类法为起点，采用目标性叙述综述方法，分析各分类类别在AGM时代后的发展，并整合历史先例与形式化保证。
AI.result: 展示了信念修正演化中的连续性与变革，识别了影响当代实现挑战的理论基础和历史先例，提供了工程化研究的基线。
AI.conclusion: 为后续构建综合历史洞见与形式化保证的计算蓝图奠定基础，推动系统化实现分析与工程导向的信念变更研究。

title: SkillComposer: Learning Reusable Skills for Natural-Language Robot Programming
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Humanoids 2026
summary: Natural-language interfaces can lower the barrier to programming robots, but existing systems struggle when users request complex tasks. While large language models (LLMs) perform well with simple commands, they often struggle to generate code for multi-step tasks, decompose high-level instructions, or reuse prior solutions. We present SkillComposer, an interactive natural-language robot programming system for simulation environments that continually learns reusable program abstractions. SkillComposer uses a generate-test architecture in which an LLM iteratively generates and revises robot programs before execution. Successful programs are stored and processed by an online library-learning algorithm that compresses recurring function sequences into reusable macro skills for future tasks. We evaluate SkillComposer through ablation experiments and a user study with 12 participants to determine its effectiveness on manipulation and robot caregiving tasks. The results show that evaluator-guided generation and learned abstractions improve success rates and usability while reducing user effort in natural-language robot programming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillComposer，一个用于仿真环境的交互式自然语言机器人编程系统，通过生成-测试架构和在线库学习算法，持续学习可复用的程序抽象，以提高复杂任务的成功率和可用性。
AI.motivation: 现有自然语言机器人编程系统在处理复杂任务时表现不佳，大型语言模型难以生成多步任务代码、分解高级指令或复用先前解决方案，需要新方法降低编程门槛并提升效率。
AI.method: SkillComposer采用生成-测试架构，LLM迭代生成并修订机器人程序，成功程序由在线库学习算法处理，压缩重复函数序列为可复用的宏技能，用于未来任务。
AI.result: 通过消融实验和12名参与者的用户研究，在操作和机器人照护任务上，评估者指导生成和学习的抽象提高了成功率、可用性，并减少了用户编程努力。
AI.conclusion: SkillComposer通过持续学习可重用抽象，有效提升了自然语言机器人编程的复杂任务处理能力，减少了用户负担，具有实际应用价值。

title: Characterizing Rhetorical Misalignment in Decision-Making with Language Models
summary: Human decision-making is often shaped by a range of well-documented cognitive biases. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into high-stakes human-AI decision-making, it is important to understand whether their outputs can amplify potential biases, how this influences human decisions, and crucially, whether it can lead to harmful consequences. In this work, we develop a decision-theoretic framework to study rhetorical misalignment, a failure mode where an LLM uses rhetorically inappropriate forms of presentation for a given decision context, thereby inducing suboptimal human decisions. We empirically investigate this phenomenon through a human-subject experiment in realistic clinical decision-making using a dataset curated from the United States Medical Licensing Examination. By measuring how LLM-generated information affects decisions, we observe that LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer. Rationales reported by participants provide evidence that these revisions are closely related to the language used by LLMs that may induce different types of cognitive biases, including anchoring, authority bias, and loss aversion. To enable scalable evaluation, we instantiate our theoretical framework using decision-makers simulated by LLMs to computationally measure rhetorical misalignment. Our findings reveal a safety concern previously unrecognized in high-stakes domains: a model can be factually aligned yet still induce harm through its rhetorical presentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出修辞错位的概念，并通过临床试验和模拟实验证明，即使LLM输出事实正确，其表达方式也可能通过认知偏差诱导人类做出有害决策。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在高风险人机决策中的集成，现有研究多关注事实准确性，忽视了表达方式可能导致的决策偏差，因此需要系统研究这种潜在危害。
AI.method: 建立决策理论框架，结合人类被试实验（基于USMLE数据集）和LLM模拟决策者进行实证分析，测量LLM信息对人类决策的影响，并分析参与者的推理过程。
AI.result: LLM平均诱导2.81%的有害决策翻转（从正确到错误），且参与者报告显示锚定效应、权威偏差和损失厌恶等认知偏差与语言相关；模拟实验也能复现该现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，即使模型事实对齐，其修辞表达也可能造成严重安全风险，需在评估中同时考虑内容与形式。

title: Decoupling Parcellation from Classification: Systematic Benchmark of Fast Brain Segmentation Methods for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
summary: Brain parcellation and classification are typically evaluated in isolation, yet downstream AD detection performance depends on their interaction. We decouple these components and systematically benchmark fast deep learning parcellation methods (SynthSeg+, OpenMAP-T1) against the FreeSurfer (FS-HV) clinical baseline through down- stream AD classification on OASIS-1. Our factorial design evaluates three parcellation methods, two volumetry strategies (hard vs. soft), and four classifier paradigms (clinical thresholds, supervised feedforward networks, ensemble methods, and foundation models with zero/few-shot prompting), with all results quantified using BCa Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了脑分割方法（SynthSeg+、OpenMAP-T1与FreeSurfer）与下游阿尔茨海默病（AD）分类的相互作用，发现分割方法的选择对AD检测性能有显著影响，且不同组合策略下性能差异明显。
AI.motivation: 脑分割和分类通常被独立评估，但下游AD检测性能依赖于两者的交互，因此需要解耦并系统比较不同分割方法与分类策略的组合。
AI.method: 采用析因设计，评估三种分割方法、两种体积测量策略（硬/软）及四种分类范式（临床阈值、监督前馈网络、集成方法、基础模型零/少样本提示），所有结果用BCa Bootstrap 95%置信区间量化。
AI.result: 不同分割方法对AD分类性能有显著影响，且分类范式与分割方法的组合效果存在差异；具体结果需参考全文详细数据。
AI.conclusion: 脑分割与分类的交互对AD检测至关重要，系统评估有助于选择最优组合，提升AD诊断的可靠性。

title: Local Gains and Fixed-Assignment Set Losses in Shared Set Decoders
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. An ancillary analysis-ready package supports exact aggregate reproduction without model inference. Code and reproduction package: https://github.com/yqjyzzz/query-interaction-reproduction
summary:
A query-relation deletion can improve the edited slot while reducing the utility of the prediction set that contains it. We study this tension in two related ResNet-50 DETR-family checkpoints using recorded, selection-conditional evidence from 710 paired image-relation units per checkpoint. The primary comparison subtracts a matched active control, which deletes the same leader source at a different recorded recipient, from the selected target deletion. It is therefore a composite contrast rather than a same-recipient placebo.
  The target-minus-control contrast is locally positive and fixed-assignment negative in both checkpoints. The opposite-sign pattern occurs within 302/710 DETR units and 460/710 DINO units. After rematching, the corresponding counts are 285/710 and 433/710. Rematching and native selection absorb enough of the mean loss for DETR intervals to cross zero, whereas DINO intervals remain negative, so persistence across readouts differs by checkpoint. A fixed-map comparison between hard deletion and a mass-preserving edit also differs before rematching. That comparison is conditional on the outcome-blind map and does not establish same-dose transport.
  Local intervention success therefore does not determine the consequence for a jointly decoded set. The supported conclusion is selection-conditional deletion sensitivity whose persistence depends on the readout and intervention operator. We do not identify an intervention-invariant edge mechanism, detector-level degradation, population prevalence, or the value of a training-time regularizer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了查询-关系删除对编辑槽位和预测集效用的影响，发现局部干预成功并不决定联合解码集的后果，删除敏感性持续性与读出和干预算子有关。
AI.motivation: 探索查询-关系删除在改进编辑槽位的同时对预测集效用的负面影响，理解局部干预与全局效应之间的张力。
AI.method: 使用两个相关的ResNet-50 DETR系列检查点，基于710个配对图像-关系单元的选择条件证据，通过减除匹配的主动对照来构建目标删除的复合对比，并进行重匹配和固定映射比较。
AI.result: 目标-对照对比在局部为正但在固定分配下为负；重匹配后DETR区间跨越零而DINO保持负值；离散删除与保质量编辑的差异在重匹配前存在。
AI.conclusion: 支持的是选择条件删除敏感性，其持续性依赖读出和干预算子；未发现不变的边缘机制、检测器级退化、总体患病率或训练时正则化的价值。

title: Position: AI Governance Needs ISO-like Interoperability Protocols, Not Just Laws
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Position Paper Track (Spotlight) (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=TE3ceHd4YU)
summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems become deeply integrated into critical global infrastructure, the urgency for robust governance frameworks has intensified. However, current approaches, led by jurisdiction-specific laws, policies, and voluntary frameworks such as the EU AI Act, China's algorithm governance, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework in the U.S., create a fragmented regulatory landscape. In this position paper, we argue that \textbf{\textit{AI governance must be built not on laws alone, but on ISO-like interoperability protocols that enable standardized, machine-readable risk communication across borders}}. Drawing on the success of the GDPR, which was operationalized through standards like ISO 27001 and Privacy by Design, we propose the development of standardized AI \textit{nutrition labels} containing unified metrics for bias, energy usage, and data provenance to facilitate cross-jurisdictional compliance. These manifests would lower barriers for small and medium enterprises (SMEs), reduce redundant regulatory efforts, and build public trust. The paper addresses concerns that standards may stifle innovation by advocating for modular, versioned protocols designed to evolve in tandem with technological change. Overall, we call for a shift from siloed legal compliance toward interoperable technical conformance, enabling a shared global language for responsible AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文主张AI治理应建立在类似ISO的互操作性协议上，而非仅依赖法律，通过标准化、机器可读的风险沟通（如AI营养标签）实现跨境合规，减少碎片化监管。
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理由不同司法辖区的法律和自愿框架主导，导致监管碎片化，难以应对AI系统的全球部署，需要统一的、技术驱动的治理机制。
AI.method: 基于GDPR和ISO标准的成功经验，提出开发统一的AI营养标签，包含偏见、能耗和数据溯源等指标，并采用模块化、版本化协议以保持技术适应性。
AI.result: 该方案有望降低中小企业合规门槛、减少重复监管努力、增强公众信任，并避免抑制创新。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁从孤立的合规转向互操作的技术一致性，构建全球共享的负责任AI部署语言。

title: DeMTS: Denoising Trajectories as Multivariate Time Series for Hallucination Detection in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for text generation. However, similar to autoregressive LLMs, D-LLMs remain vulnerable to hallucinations, where fluent outputs may contain factually incorrect or unsupported content. Although existing hallucination detection methods for D-LLMs attempt to leverage uncertainty trajectories of the denoising process to better identify hallucination signals, they typically compress the trajectories along either the temporal or token dimension, overlooking the useful information encoded in the complete two-dimensional token-step structure. Consequently, they may fail to capture hallucination-relevant patterns, such as inconsistent convergence and cross-token fault propagation, leading to suboptimal detection performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a D-LLM hallucination detection framework that formulates the Denoising trajectories as Multivariate Time Series over learnable latent variables (DeMTS for short). DeMTS employs a trajectory-preserving token-to-variable assignment module to convert token signals into stable latent variables. Based on these variables, we propose dynamic multivariate temporal modeling to progressively integrate inter-variable dependency modeling with temporal encoding for hallucination prediction. Extensive experiments on two D-LLMs backbones and three benchmarks demonstrate that DeMTS outperforms existing hallucination detection methods while maintaining strong robustness, efficiency, and cross-task transferability.

AI.tldr: 提出DeMTS框架，将扩散大语言模型的去噪轨迹建模为多变量时间序列，通过保留轨迹的二维结构来检测幻觉，在多个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有D-LLM幻觉检测方法压缩去噪轨迹的时序或token维度，丢失了二维结构中的关键模式（如不一致收敛和跨token故障传播），导致检测性能次优。
AI.method: DeMTS将去噪轨迹表示为潜在变量上的多变量时间序列，采用轨迹保留的token到变量分配模块，并结合动态多变量时间建模，集成变量间依赖与时间编码进行幻觉预测。
AI.result: 在两个D-LLM骨干和三个基准上，DeMTS优于现有幻觉检测方法，并具有强鲁棒性、高效性和跨任务可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: DeMTS有效利用完整二维轨迹结构，显著提升D-LLM幻觉检测性能，为相关研究提供了新思路。

title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios. Each video-question-answer instance is independently verified by three human experts to ensure both correctness and appropriate difficulty. All evaluated MLLMs, including frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA, highlighting its value as a high-quality and timely benchmark for evaluating next-generation MLLMs. We hope that VideoGAIA will facilitate the transition from conventional video understanding toward agentic video understanding.

AI.tldr: VideoGAIA 是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型智能体的视频理解基准，通过多轮、工具增强的交互过程来测试模型，现有模型准确率均低于60%。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准（如Video-MME）已趋于饱和，顶尖模型准确率接近90%，难以区分高级模型的智能水平，需要更复杂、更接近真实应用的基准。
AI.method: 构建包含271个模型与人类共同设计任务的基准，任务涉及多轮交互和工具调用，每项任务由三位专家独立验证，确保正确性和难度。
AI.result: 所有评估的模型（包括GPT-5.5和Kimi-K3）在VideoGAIA上的准确率均低于60%，表明该基准具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: VideoGAIA是评估下一代多模态大模型的有价值且及时的基准，有望推动视频理解从传统单轮问答转向智能体式的多轮交互理解。

title: Admissibility-Preserving Control for Strict-Feedback Nonlinear Systems with Asymmetric Actuator Constraints
summary: This paper develops Admissibility-Preserving Control (APC), a realization-centered safety-critical control framework for strict-feedback systems subject to asymmetric actuator limits, time-varying output constraints, and actuator-rate limitations. APC denotes the overall control architecture, whereas an Admissibility-Preserving Input Realization (APIR) denotes its constraint-realization module. Therein, the APIR dynamically generates the physical plant input while rendering its prescribed asymmetric actuator set forward invariant. In contrast to algebraic clipping and post-design saturation compensation, the actuator limits are embedded directly in a continuously differentiable dynamic realization with user-selectable regularity and interpretable tuning parameters. The APIR is integrated with recursive backstepping by treating the realized plant input as an additional state. The resulting design does not require an input-to-state stability assumption on the uncontrolled plant. Instead, the nonlinear drift terms are compensated recursively, subject to an explicit compatibility condition between the desired motion, the available control authority, and the APIR interior gain. The framework is further extended to time-varying output-safe tracking through a smooth asymmetric logarithmic barrier coordinate and its associated Lyapunov function and to simultaneous actuator-magnitude and rate constraints through a cascaded APIR. Rigorous Lyapunov and invariance analyses establish regional asymptotic tracking, forward invariance of the compatible admissible sets, and boundedness of all closed-loop signals. Numerical studies illustrate asymmetric actuator utilization, output-safety preservation, and magnitude-rate constraint enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以实现为中心的 safety-critical 控制框架（APC），用于处理严格反馈系统中的非对称执行器限制、时变输出约束和执行器速率限制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如代数裁剪和饱和补偿）无法在动态过程中直接处理执行器限制，且需要输入-状态稳定性假设。本文旨在通过动态实现模块（APIR）将执行器限制嵌入控制设计中，以放宽假设并提高适用性。
AI.method: APC 框架包含 APIR 模块，通过连续可微的动态实现生成物理输入，并保持非对称执行器集合的前向不变性。结合递归反步法，将实现后的输入视为附加状态，无需输入-状态稳定性假设。扩展部分引入平滑非对称对数障碍坐标处理时变输出约束，并通过级联 APIR 处理幅度与速率限制。
AI.result: 严格 Lyapunov 和不变性分析证明了区域渐近跟踪、兼容可容许集合的前向不变性以及所有闭环信号的有界性。数值研究展示了非对称执行器利用、输出安全保持和幅度-速率约束执行。
AI.conclusion: APC 框架提供了一种通用且可解释的方法来同时处理执行器限制和输出约束，放宽了现有假设，并通过动态实现提升安全性和性能。

title: BiCRVC: An Efficient Bidirectional Neural Video Compression Framework via Coupled Representation Coding
summary: Neural video compression (NVC) has achieved strong compression performance, but practical random-access coding still faces two technical challenges: existing bidirectional NVCs (BVCs) usually require costly motion-first decoding, and reliable motion estimation is difficult under long-range bidirectional prediction. To address these issues, we present BiCRVC, an efficient bidirectional neural video compression framework based on coupled representation coding. Instead of coding motion and frame information with two separate codecs, BiCRVC transforms the motion representation and the current-frame latent into a unified latent representation for entropy coding. This design enables motion and frame information to be decoded from the same bitstream with one unified codec, while still reconstructing motion-aligned contexts for frame decoding. To improve motion accuracy, we introduce multi-candidate motion estimation (MCME), which combines multi-scale motion estimation and parallel accumulated motion estimation to better handle diverse and long-range motions. To reduce motion coding overhead, we further propose bidirectional motion feature propagation (BMFP), which reuses previously decoded motion features at both the encoder and decoder as temporal priors for conditional motion coding. In addition, coupled distortion training and random GOP structure training are used to encourage joint motion-frame coding and improve adaptation to hierarchical random-access structures. Experiments show that BiCRVC achieves better compression performance than state-of-the-art BVCs while providing about 30 times faster 1080p decoding than recent BVCs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BiCRVC，一种基于耦合表示编码的高效双向神经视频压缩框架，通过统一编解码运动与帧信息，结合多候选运动估计和双向运动特征传播，实现了更优的压缩性能和约30倍更快的1080p解码速度。
AI.motivation: 现有双向神经视频压缩（BVC）存在两个问题：一是需要昂贵的运动优先解码，二是长距离双向预测中运动估计不可靠，导致随机访问编码效率低。
AI.method: 提出耦合表示编码（将运动表示和当前帧潜变量统一编码）、多候选运动估计（MCME，结合多尺度和平行累积运动估计）、双向运动特征传播（BMFP，复用已解码运动特征作为条件先验），并采用耦合失真训练和随机GOP结构训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，BiCRVC在压缩性能上优于现有BVC，同时1080p解码速度比近期BVC快约30倍。
AI.conclusion: BiCRVC通过统一编码设计和改进运动处理，有效解决了双向神经视频压缩中的解码速度与运动估计问题，实现了更高效的随机访问编码。

title: Position: Certified Correctness in Neural Constraint Reasoning Requires Symbolic Integration
comment: Accept by ICML 2026
summary: Neural solvers for constraint satisfaction problems have achieved remarkable in-distribution accuracy, yet they suffer from a fundamental limitation persistent constraint violations occur under distribution shifts even when the model reports high confidence. This position paper argues that when hard constraints exist and the cost of verification is relatively low, neural constraint reasoning must prioritize symbolic integration over pure learning. We justify our focus on Sudoku as a representative NP-complete testbed because it exhibits a sharp asymmetry between easy verification and hard solving: checking a candidate solution requires only polynomial time $O(n^{2})$, while finding a solution may require exponential search. Through a comprehensive survey of solving methods spanning deterministic algorithms, metaheuristic optimization, learning-based approaches, and language-conditioned reasoning, we demonstrate that neural-only methods without instance-level certification fail to achieve the provable correctness that symbolic and neuro-symbolic approaches provide. We advocate for a bidirectional integration in which neural methods enhance symbolic solvers by learning heuristics and converting percepts into symbols, while symbolic methods verify neural outputs to ensure their reliability. To operationalize this position, we propose a multi-agent certified reasoning framework that demonstrates how this integration can achieve both computational efficiency and provable correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在硬约束且验证成本低的问题中，神经约束推理应优先采用符号集成而非纯学习，并提出一种多智能体认证推理框架以实现高效与可证明正确性。
AI.motivation: 神经求解器在分布内准确率高，但在分布偏移下即使置信度高也会出现持续违规，缺乏可证明的正确性。
AI.method: 通过综述和论证，提出神经与符号双向集成：神经方法学习启发式并将感知转化为符号，符号方法验证神经输出；具体实现为多智能体认证推理框架。
AI.result: 神经-only方法无法提供实例级认证，而符号和神经符号方法能提供可证明正确性；所提框架兼具计算效率和可证明正确性。
AI.conclusion: 在硬约束与低成本验证场景下，应优先采用神经符号集成，以平衡效率与可靠性。

title: Evidence of Absence: Cross-Modal Abductive Risk Perception to Sustain World Models When Vision Fails
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Working draft prepared for journal submission
summary: A structured world-state (entities, relations, context, and predictive cues) is designed to preserve prediction-critical content when perception degrades, but it presumes observations to populate it; when the primary visual modality is occluded or degraded, those observations may be missing. We address how to sustain the world model from a complementary modality by treating the absence of expected co-evidence as evidence of a hidden cause. The abductive framework is modality-agnostic; this article instantiates it acoustically. A microphone-array front-end estimates the bearing of engine and tire sources and extracts approach-rate evidence (Doppler when a stable tone exists, a broadband looming readout otherwise); the event "signature present, visual co-evidence absent" then triggers abductive inference of a hidden road user, emitting a calibrated risk advisory rather than a control command. Recoverability of the hidden state is analyzed as an identifiability question separating shared from modality-unique information, and cueing is cast as Neyman-Pearson detection under an explicit false-alarm budget. On real occluded-approach recordings at blind junctions, the method warns a mean 1.7 seconds before line-of-sight entry, matches the sustained-window variant of the published acoustic baseline's detection rate with 42% fewer false alarms, localizes to 3.4 degrees median once in view, is well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.034), and keeps hazard awareness above 0.87 under staged vision degradation that collapses a vision-only channel to 0.03. We also measure the method's limits: calibration transfers to an unseen junction almost losslessly, the signature classifier does not, and moving-ego noise is the binding deployment constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种跨模态推理框架，在视觉感知退化时，利用声学证据通过溯因推理维持对隐藏道路使用者的世界模型，实现早于视线到达的预警，并显著降低误报率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型依赖视觉观测，当视觉模态被遮挡或退化时，观测缺失导致模型失效，需要从互补模态（如声学）获取证据来推断隐藏状态。
AI.method: 设计模态无关的溯因推理框架，使用麦克风阵列提取声源方位和接近速率证据，将“预期视觉共证缺失”视为隐藏原因的证据，触发隐式道路使用者的推理，并输出风险提示而非控制指令。可识别性分析区分共享与模态独有信息，提示采用Neyman-Pearson检测控制虚警。
AI.result: 在真实遮挡盲区场景中，平均提前1.7秒预警，检测率与声学基线持平但误报减少42%，定位中位误差3.4度，校准误差0.034，在视觉退化时危险意识保持0.87以上（视觉通道仅0.03）。校准可迁移至新路口，但分类器不可迁移，移动本车噪声是主要部署限制。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态溯因推理能有效弥补视觉退化，但分类器泛化性和自车噪声仍是实际应用需要解决的关键问题。

title: GaussMemory: Task-Driven 3D Gaussian Scene Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally relies on persistent spatial memory. However, existing 3D memory systems function merely as passive recorders: they store observations using fixed, hand-crafted rules, treating every scene element--whether a critical grasp target or an irrelevant background wall--with equal importance. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from passive storage to active, task-driven spatial memory. We argue that a robot's memory should not simply record what it sees, but actively learn how to remember--discovering which objects to track precisely, how aggressively to update them, and what to discard, all learned end-to-end without hand-designed rules. Crucially, this active paradigm is realized by unifying memory update and readout as two sides of the same cognitive process, enabling bidirectional flow where task needs shape update strategies and vice versa. To instantiate this vision, we introduce GaussMemory, which leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting as a persistent geometric substrate. On LIBERO, GaussMemory outperforms MemoryVLA on Goal and Long-10; on VLABench, it surpasses $π_0$-FAST by +5.2% (Track 1) and +6.0% (Track 6).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种主动的、任务驱动的空间记忆范式（GaussMemory），将记忆更新与读取统一为双向认知过程，在长时程机器人操作任务中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D记忆系统仅作为被动记录器，使用固定规则存储所有场景元素，无法区分关键目标与无关背景，限制了长时程操作任务的性能。
AI.method: 提出GaussMemory，利用3D高斯泼溅作为几何基础，通过端到端学习实现记忆更新与读取的统一，使任务需求指导更新策略，反之亦然。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，GaussMemory在Goal和Long-10任务上优于MemoryVLA；在VLABench上，比π0-FAST在Track 1和Track 6上分别提升+5.2%和+6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 主动、可学习的空间记忆范式能显著提升长时程机器人操作的性能，验证了记忆更新与读取统一设计的有效性。

title: DeCo-MIL: Debiased Counterfactual Reasoning for Long-Tailed Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used for weakly supervised whole slide image (WSI) analysis. However, under long-tailed distributions, MIL-based WSI analysis faces a nested dual long-tail: an inter-slide class long tail and an intra-slide long tail of instance-level discriminative evidence. The two long tails are coupled: tail classes have few training slides, while their limited diagnostic evidence is concentrated in a few patches and obscured by abundant within-bag redundancy. This coupling biases models toward head classes and degrades rare-class recognition. To address this, we propose DeCo-MIL for long-tailed WSI analysis, which jointly alleviates the nested dual long-tail through frequency-debiased counterfactual reasoning. For the inner long tail, DeCo-MIL clusters patches into tissue-morphology anchors, replaces each anchor with its matched normal prototype to perform a counterfactual intervention, and estimates its counterfactual contribution to the ground-truth class using class-frequency-corrected predictions. These contributions guide redundancy masking to preserve scarce discriminative instances. For the outer long tail, DeCo-MIL constructs anchor-stratified pseudo-bags from redundancy-reduced bags and combines tail-aware oversampling with consistency regularization, increasing effective supervision for tail classes while preserving tissue-morphology composition. Extensive experiments on three long-tailed WSI benchmarks demonstrate that DeCo-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tail-class recognition and overall classification.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCo-MIL方法，通过频率去偏的反事实推理联合缓解全切片图像分析中嵌套的双重长尾问题，提升尾类识别和整体分类性能。
AI.motivation: 长尾分布下，MIL-based WSI分析面临切片间类别长尾和切片内实例证据长尾的嵌套问题，两者耦合导致模型偏向头部类，尾类识别性能下降。
AI.method: DeCo-MIL方法：内部长尾通过组织形态锚点聚类和正常原型反事实干预，估计反事实贡献并指导冗余掩码；外部长尾通过锚点分层伪包、尾类过采样和一致性正则化增强尾类监督。
AI.result: 在三个长尾WSI基准上，DeCo-MIL在尾类识别和整体分类上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: DeCo-MIL有效解耦和缓解嵌套双重长尾，提升长尾WSI分析的鲁棒性和尾类识别能力。

title: Automatic or Controlled? Repetition Priming Reveals Divergent Processing in Base LLMs, Instruct LLMs, and Humans
summary: Words recur constantly in natural language use, yet it remains unclear whether language models reactivate prior representations or re-evaluate repeated words afresh, and whether post-training changes this default behavior. We apply repetition priming (Shiffrin and Schneider, 1977) to 15 models across five model families (1.5B-14B parameters) in two tasks, semantic categorization and cloze completion, with matched human experiments using identical stimuli. We find that base models exhibit automatic processing: they show immediate facilitation that remains stable across lags, partially survives context removal, and correlates with attention to prior occurrences. Instruct models exhibit controlled processing: their facilitation decays with lag, collapses without expected context, and reverses to interference at larger scales. Within the Qwen 2.5 family, this dissociation increases monotonically with model scale, suggesting that post-training progressively alters repetition processing. Humans show a hybrid profile, with lag-sensitive facilitation resembling instruct models but without interference, suggesting that neither model type fully captures human cognition. Our findings reveal a qualitative shift in how language models process repeated information after post-training and provide mechanistic evidence for the divergence between model behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过重复启动实验，比较了15个基础模型与指令微调模型在重复词处理上的差异，发现基础模型表现出自动加工（稳定易化），而指令模型表现出受控加工（延迟衰减、干扰效应），且该差异随规模增大而增强，但两者均未完全匹配人类行为。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中词汇频繁重复，但语言模型是否重新激活先前表征还是重新评估重复词仍不清楚，且训练后（post-training）是否改变此默认行为尚未研究。
AI.method: 对15个模型（1.5B-14B，5个系列）应用重复启动范式，执行语义分类和完形填空任务，并用相同刺激进行人类行为实验对照。
AI.result: 基础模型显示自动加工：即时易化、跨延迟稳定、部分抵抗上下文移除、关注先前出现；指令模型显示受控加工：延迟衰减、上下文移除后易化消失、大规模时转为干扰；Qwen 2.5系列中该分离随规模单调增强；人类表现出混合模式（类似指令模型的延迟敏感性但无干扰）。
AI.conclusion: 后训练使语言模型处理重复信息的方式发生质性转变，提供模型行为分歧的机制证据，且两种模型均未完全符合人类认知。

authors: Kurios Iuri Pinheiro de Melo Queiroz
title: Multi-Observer Output Feedback Stabilization of a Class of Uncertain Nonminimum-Phase Systems
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures
summary: This paper addresses the challenging problem of output feedback stabilization for nonlinear nonminimum phase (NMP) systems in the presence of parametric uncertainties and external disturbances. The proposed framework integrates three distinct observers: a reduced-order observer for reconstructing the unmeasured states of the internal (zero) dynamics, a high-gain observer for estimating output derivatives, and an observer for estimating the aggregated effect of parametric uncertainties and disturbances. Leveraging these estimates, a sliding mode control law is synthesized to ensure global asymptotic stability of the entire system using only output measurements. The control design requires only partial model knowledge, significantly relaxing the restrictive assumptions common in existing literature. Numerical simulations illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed output-feedback strategy and corroborate the theoretical developments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对具有参数不确定性和外部干扰的非线性非最小相位系统，提出了一种仅需输出测量的输出反馈镇定方法。该方法结合降阶观测器、高增益观测器和扰动观测器，并设计滑模控制律，实现了全局渐近稳定，且只需部分模型知识。
AI.motivation: 现有非线性非最小相位系统的输出反馈镇定方法通常要求严格的模型假设（如全状态可测或精确模型），难以处理参数不确定性和外部干扰。本文旨在放松这些限制，仅利用输出测量实现鲁棒镇定。
AI.method: 提出一个集成框架：降阶观测器重建内部（零）动态的未测状态，高增益观测器估计输出导数，另一个观测器估计不确定性和干扰的聚合效应。基于这些估计，合成滑模控制律，仅需部分模型知识。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了所提输出反馈策略的有效性，证实了全局渐近稳定性的理论结果，并展示了在不确定性和干扰下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了非线性非最小相位系统在不确定性和干扰下的输出反馈镇定问题，放宽了现有文献中的严格假设，为实际应用提供了更可行的控制方案。

title: Position: Want Better ML Reviews? Stop Asking Nicely and Start Incentivizing with a Credit System
summary: With soaring submission counts, stricter reciprocal review policies, widespread adoption of platforms like OpenReview, and without the offsetting pressure of publication fees, the machine learning (ML) community has one of the largest scholarly presences among all scientific fields. And yet, \textbf{almost \textit{everyone} has \textit{many} unpleasant things to share about their review experience.} Worse, there is little public space to seriously discuss, let alone debate, what makes a review system effective or how it might be improved.\quad In this position paper, we expand our discussion from two core problems: \textit{How can we reasonably limit submission volume?} and \textit{How can we incentivize good and discourage bad reviewing?} We first assess the strengths and shortcomings of existing attempts to address such problems. Specifically, we present four takes on some popular conference mechanisms and propose two alternative designs for improvement.\quad Our general position is that meaningful improvement in ML peer review won't come from polite best-practice suggestions tucked into Calls for Papers or Reviewer Guidelines: it requires \textbf{enforceable yet fine-grained procedural safeguards} paired with \textbf{a currency-like credit system (e.g., our proposed \textit{OpenReview Points})}. ML practitioners can ``earn'' such points by contributing good review practices, and ``spend'' them across one or multiple major conferences to redeem different kinds of ``perks,'' such as complimentary registration or the right to request additional review resources.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，针对机器学习社区中同行评审普遍不满的现状，提出通过可执行的程序性保障和类似货币的信用系统（如OpenReview Points）来改进评审流程，并讨论了两种新设计。
AI.motivation: 机器学习社区投稿量激增，评审体验普遍不佳，且缺乏公开讨论和有效改进机制，促使作者探讨如何限制投稿量并激励良好评审行为。
AI.method: 作者首先评估现有会议机制的优缺点，然后提出两种替代设计，核心包括可执行的程序性保障和基于信用点的激励系统（OpenReview Points），通过挣取和花费积分来奖励良好评审行为。
AI.result: 文章指出现有机制多依赖劝告性建议，效果有限；提出的信用系统有望通过经济激励和制度约束改善评审质量，但尚未经过实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，真正改善ML同行评审需要强制性、细粒度的程序规则与信用积分系统相结合，而非仅靠最佳实践建议。

title: A cross-modal generative model for incomplete and degraded prostate MRI with multicentre clinical validation
summary: Missing or degraded sequences can limit prostate multiparametric MRI. We developed MSCNet, a sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative framework for reconstructing unavailable contrasts and restoring degraded acquisitions. Across ten completion tasks, task-specific MSCNet achieved mean structural similarity of 0.818 versus 0.798 for the strongest task-matched comparators; matched-capacity analyses showed larger differences in lesion fidelity and boundary preservation. In a blinded 1,000-case reader study, overall image quality met the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for DWI, ADC and T2W completion, but not T1W. In a separate 200-case diagnostic assessment, AUCs for clinically significant cancer were 0.860 with acquired images, 0.841 with MSCNet and 0.797 with baseline-generated images. A locked 186-case three-hospital cohort supported multicentre transportability. These retrospective results support quality-controlled cross-modal reconstruction as an adjunct to acquired prostate MRI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSCNet，一种序列条件的跨模态生成框架，用于重建缺失或退化的前列腺多参数MRI序列。在多个任务中，MSCNet在图像质量和癌症诊断方面优于基线方法，并支持多中心可迁移性，可作为获取图像的辅助手段。
AI.motivation: 前列腺多参数MRI中可能存在序列缺失或质量退化，这会影响诊断的准确性和完整性。现有的重建方法在跨模态任务中性能有限，需要一种能够有效重建缺失对比度并恢复退化采集的框架。
AI.method: MSCNet采用序列条件跨模态生成框架，针对十个完成任务训练任务特定模型，并通过匹配容量分析评估病变保真度和边界保持。通过1000例盲法读者研究评估图像质量，200例诊断评估比较临床显著性癌症的AUC，186例三中心队列验证可迁移性。
AI.result: MSCNet在平均结构相似性上达到0.818，优于最强对比方法的0.798；图像质量非劣效性在DWI、ADC和T2W完成中达标，但T1W未达标；诊断AUC为0.860（获取图像）、0.841（MSCNet）和0.797（基线生成），并验证了多中心可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 质量控制的跨模态重建可作为获取的前列腺MRI的辅助手段，在退化或缺失场景下提供有价值的替代方案，但需注意T1W重建的限制。

title: Domain Agnostic Text Redaction from Natural Language Rules using Instruction Tuning
summary: With the increasing digitization of personal and corporate communication, the automatic sanitization of textual data has become a crucial component of data privacy and compliance frameworks. Traditional text sanitization solutions are majorly suitable for obscuring sensitive data with standard structure such as Personal Identifiable Information (PII). These solutions do not provide transparent justification for their redaction, which makes it difficult to audit them. This paper introduces an explainable, domain-agnostic text redaction solution that uses natural language rules of redaction, applied via an instruction-tuned language model, to identify and redact sensitive information in unstructured documents. Unlike traditional text sanitization, this method enables a user to conveniently define any sensitive information; which may be structured (e.g.\ PII) or unstructured (e.g.\ legal terms and conditions) in natural language. A general-purpose LLM generates or augments these natural language rules of redaction from the user's definition, which are then used to instruction-fine-tune a smaller language model that reasons the rules step-by-step over any given document to identify and redact the corresponding sensitive content, while providing transparent justifications for each redaction and highlighting the specific rule that triggered the decision. This explanation is generated in natural language to support human reviewers and auditors in understanding why specific content was redacted. A reconstruction-based metric is used to estimate the probability of recovering redacted information from the sanitized document, quantifying redaction coverage. The solution shows high reconstruction error and high redaction precision, making it suitable for automated text sanitization in critical applications such as legal discovery, medical documentation, and corporate information governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释、领域无关的文本脱敏解决方案，通过指令微调的语言模型应用自然语言脱敏规则，识别并遮蔽非结构化文档中的敏感信息，并生成自然语言解释以支持审计，使用基于重建的指标评估脱敏覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 传统文本脱敏方案主要适用于遮蔽具有标准结构的个人可识别信息(PII)，缺乏透明的脱敏理由，难以审计；且无法灵活定义非结构化敏感信息(如法律条款)。
AI.method: 使用指令微调的语言模型，用户以自然语言定义敏感信息，通用LLM生成或增强脱敏规则，再微调较小的语言模型，使其逐步推理规则以识别和遮蔽敏感内容，同时提供每个脱敏决策的触发规则和自然语言解释；使用基于重建的指标估计从脱敏文档中恢复信息的概率。
AI.result: 所提方案实现了高重建误差和高脱敏精度，适用于法律发现、医疗文档和企业信息治理等关键应用。
AI.conclusion: 该可解释脱敏方法有效解决了传统方案的局限，提供了透明、可审计的自动化文本脱敏能力，适合在关键领域部署。

title: Output Feedback Adaptive Performance Control
summary: In this paper, we consider uncertain high-order nonlinear systems performing dynamic tracking tasks under hard actuator constraints, where only the output error is available for measurement, while the system states and the desired trajectory derivatives are unavailable for feedback. We propose a robust output-feedback controller that guarantees adaptive performance specifications in this framework. The proposed scheme employs a novel Prescribed Performance Observer (PPO) with dynamic gains, which enhances estimation accuracy while avoiding large fixed observer gains. In addition, we introduce an adaptive mechanism that dynamically adjusts the output performance specifications according to the actuator limitations, ensuring bounded closed-loop signals. We establish a separation principle showing that the output-feedback scheme recovers the performance of its state-feedback counterpart. Comparative simulations demonstrate accurate tracking and smoother applied control under actuator limitations, uncertainties, and measurement noise.

AI.tldr: 本文针对执行器受限、状态不可测的高阶不确定非线性系统，提出了一种基于新型指定性能观测器的鲁棒输出反馈控制器，实现了规定的动态跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有输出反馈控制方法在处理执行器饱和、状态未知和性能约束时，往往需要较大的观测器增益或无法同时保证跟踪性能与执行器安全，因此需要一种能自适应调整性能规格并避免过大增益的方案。
AI.method: 设计了一种动态增益的指定性能观测器（PPO），并引入自适应机制，根据执行器限制动态调整输出性能边界，进而构造输出反馈控制器，并建立分离原理证明其性能恢复性。
AI.result: 仿真表明，在执行器限制、不确定性和测量噪声下，所提方法实现了精确跟踪和更平滑的控制输入，且比状态反馈方案性能更优。
AI.conclusion: 提出的输出反馈方案能够在不直接测量状态和参考轨迹导数的情况下，保证预定的跟踪性能，同时适应执行器饱和，为实际工程提供了一种有效解决方案。

title: AeroGround: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Aerial-Ground Collaborative Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely employed in understanding and reasoning tasks for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Existing UAV benchmarks primarily focus on aerial-view scenarios. However, whether current VLMs can perform well on understanding and reasoning tasks in aerial-ground collaborative scenarios which are practical in real-world applications like rescue and infrastructure inspection remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AeroGround, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning. AeroGround is built upon a simulated aerial-ground dataset containing approximately 29,000 multimodal observation groups from diverse open environments, and provides 2,250 high-quality question-answering instances covering cross-view correspondence, spatial understanding, and reasoning. Experiments on 16 pretrained VLMs, together with two domain-adapted variants, reveal a substantial gap between current models and human performance: the best model achieves an average accuracy of 54.4%, whereas humans reach 93.3%. By systematically revealing the strengths and limitations of existing models in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning, AeroGround provides a foundation for developing more capable aerial-ground collaborative embodied intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AeroGround，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在空地协同推理任务中的基准，包含约29,000个多模态观测组和2,250个问答实例，实验发现当前最佳模型准确率仅为54.4%，远低于人类的93.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机基准主要关注空中视角，但空地协同场景在实际应用中至关重要，而当前VLMs在此类场景的理解和推理能力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建了基于模拟空地数据集的多模态观测组，设计了涵盖跨视角对应、空间理解和推理的高质量问答实例，并评估了16个预训练VLM及两个领域自适应变体。
AI.result: 最佳模型平均准确率为54.4%，而人类达到93.3%，表明当前VLMs在空地协同推理中与人类存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: AeroGround揭示了现有模型在空地协同推理中的优势与局限，为开发更强大的空地协同具身智能系统提供了基础。

title: HP2-SLAM: Adaptive Hybrid ICP for Robust and Efficient LiDAR SLAM
summary: Achieving robustness, accuracy, and efficiency simultaneously remains a central challenge in light detection and ranging (LiDAR) simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). While learning-based approaches deliver strong benchmark performance, they often require extensive training, substantial computational resources, and struggle to generalize to unseen or degenerate environments. Geometry-based methods are efficient and interpretable, yet their performance degrades in planar or repetitive scenes due to limitations of standard iterative closest point (ICP) formulations. We present HP2-SLAM, a minimalist yet robust LiDAR SLAM framework built around a neighborhood-size adaptive hybrid ICP. Our key insight is a planarity-aware adaptive threshold that dynamically classifies correspondences based on local geometric structure and density, thereby enabling a principled balance between point-to-plane and point-to-point residuals. This formulation stabilizes alignment in both structured and degenerate environments without feature engineering, learning modules, or dataset-specific tuning. Integrated into a complete SLAM pipeline with submap management, loop closure detection, and pose graph optimization, HP2-SLAM consistently outperforms strong geometry-based baselines across publicly available datasets while maintaining real-time performance on commodity hardware. Our results demonstrate that carefully designed geometric adaptation can achieve strong generalization and robustness without sacrificing simplicity or efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HP2-SLAM，一种基于邻域自适应混合ICP的轻量级LiDAR SLAM框架，通过平面感知的自适应阈值动态分类对应关系，平衡点面与点点残差，在不使用学习模块的情况下，实现了鲁棒、准确且高效的定位与建图，并在多个公开数据集上优于几何基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR SLAM方法中，学习式方法性能好但需大量训练且泛化差；几何方法高效可解释但在平面或重复场景中因ICP限制而性能下降。因此，需要一种无需训练、泛化强且高效的几何方法。
AI.method: 提出一种平面感知的自适应阈值，基于局部几何结构和密度动态分类对应关系，混合使用点面与点点残差，并集成完整的SLAM流程，包括子图管理、回环检测和位姿图优化。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上，HP2-SLAM一致优于强几何基线，并在普通硬件上保持实时性能，验证了其强泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的几何自适应方法可以在不牺牲简洁性和效率的前提下，实现强泛化与鲁棒性，为LiDAR SLAM提供了一种简单而可靠的方案。

title: What Matters is the Prompt: Prompt Sensitivity and Prompt Generation in Foundation Models for Lung Nodule Segmentation
summary: Lung nodule segmentation in computed tomography is essential for extracting clinically relevant information for lung cancer assessment and treatment planning. Foundation models have shown notable segmentation capabilities, but state-of-the-art approaches often depend on input prompts, such as points or boxes, making their performance sensitive to prompt quality and placement. Understanding the limitations and constraints of prompt-based foundation models is therefore essential for designing reliable medical image segmentation solutions. In this work, we investigate how prompt quality affects foundation models performance for lung nodule segmentation. We further propose a synthetic prompt-generation model to test if the dependence on manually provided prompts can be mitigated by generating synthetic prompts that can also improve segmentation performance. Perturbation experiments show that bounding box prompts generally outperform point prompts, while latest specialized medical imaging models achieve better performance than general purpose ones. The proposed approach obtains a Dice coefficient of 0.85, suggesting that synthetic prompt generation as a promising strategy for lung nodule segmentation with foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了提示质量对基础模型在肺结节分割中的影响，并提出合成提示生成模型以提升性能，最终Dice系数达0.85。
AI.motivation: 基础模型分割性能依赖输入提示质量，但提示的敏感性和人工提示的依赖性限制了可靠性，需要系统评估并探索替代方案。
AI.method: 通过扰动实验对比边界框和点提示，并设计合成提示生成模型以自动生成提示，用于提升分割性能。
AI.result: 边界框提示优于点提示，专用医学模型优于通用模型，合成提示方法达到Dice 0.85。
AI.conclusion: 合成提示生成是提升肺结节分割性能的有效策略，可减弱对人工提示的依赖，有助于设计可靠的分割方案。

title: Longitudinal and Graph-Augmented Prediction of Adolescent Substance Use Onset in the ABCD Study
comment: 8 pages main text, 10 pages total, 4 tables
summary: Early identification of adolescent substance-use risk is an important prevention challenge, yet the relative value of baseline characteristics, longitudinal trajectories, and relational context remains unclear. Using data from approximately 11,860 participants in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, we compare cross-sectional, longitudinal, and graph-based approaches for predicting alcohol sipping, alcohol use, marijuana use, and alcohol/marijuana use. We evaluate tree-based models, recurrent neural networks, and Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (T-GCNs) constructed from family, school, and feature-similarity graphs. Longitudinal models consistently outperform baseline models, with temporal XGBoost achieving the strongest standalone performance. Although T-GCNs generally do not surpass temporal XGBoost, graph-derived risk scores provide complementary information. Combining temporal XGBoost and T-GCN predictions through score-level stacking yields the best performance across all outcomes, achieving AUC-ROC values above 0.79. Feature analyses identify peer deviance, age, externalizing symptoms, parental monitoring, cultural norms, and neighborhood context as important predictors of substance use onset. These findings demonstrate the value of longitudinal modeling for substance-use prediction and suggest that graph-based representations can provide effective auxiliary risk signals.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用ABCD研究中约11860名青少年的数据，比较了横截面、纵向和基于图的方法预测物质使用风险，发现纵向模型优于基线模型，结合图神经网络和XGBoost的堆叠模型表现最佳，AUC超过0.79。
AI.motivation: 早期识别青少年物质使用风险是重要的预防挑战，但基线特征、纵向轨迹和关系背景的相对价值尚不清楚。
AI.method: 比较了横截面、纵向和基于图的方法，包括树模型、循环神经网络和基于家庭、学校及特征相似性图构建的T-GCN，并采用分数级堆叠整合预测。
AI.result: 纵向模型优于基线模型，时间XGBoost表现最强；T-GCN单独表现不如时间XGBoost，但图派生的风险分数提供补充信息，堆叠模型在所有结果上AUC达到0.79以上。
AI.conclusion: 纵向建模对物质使用预测有价值，图表示可提供有效的辅助风险信号，关键预测因子包括同伴不良行为、年龄、外化症状、父母监控、文化规范和邻里环境。

title: $S^3$: A Smooth Simulation Surrogate for Optimizing Discrete Abstractions of Dynamical Systems
summary: Intelligent systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings with black-box controllers, including neural networks. The properties and behaviors of these end-to-end systems can be studied with abstraction-based methods that replace them with simpler finite models. Constructing such abstractions requires balancing the soundness of over-approximating the dynamical system against conservatism, which manifests as spurious or excessive nondeterministic behaviors. Bi-simulation theory provides principled metrics for characterizing these relationships, but does not prescribe how to construct sound abstractions with minimal conservatism. We fill this gap with a smooth simulation surrogate ($S^3$) --- a differentiable objective that approximates the reverse simulation metric used to quantify conservatism. Combined with Taylor model-based reachability, $S^3$ enables gradient-based optimization of abstraction parameters while preserving soundness by construction. We evaluate this optimization pipeline on three case studies. Our results show that $S^3$ is strongly correlated with the reverse simulation metric, is computationally faster, and serves as an effective objective for reducing abstraction conservatism.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为S^3的可微优化目标，用于在保持可靠性的同时减少抽象系统的保守性，结合泰勒模型可达性分析，在多个案例中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 智能系统在安全关键场景中常使用黑箱控制器，抽象方法用简单有限模型替代复杂系统，但现有抽象构建方法难以平衡可靠性与保守性，缺乏系统性的优化手段。
AI.method: 提出S^3（平滑仿真替代）作为反向仿真度量的可微近似，结合泰勒模型可达性分析，通过梯度优化抽象参数，同时保证抽象的音效性。
AI.result: S^3与反向仿真度量强相关，计算更快，并有效减少抽象保守性，在三个案例研究中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: S^3为抽象参数优化提供了高效且可靠的工具，能够显著降低保守性，有助于在安全关键系统中应用基于抽象的分析方法。

title: NPU Offloading of a Frozen Visual Encoder for Robot Policy Training
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
summary: When a robot policy is trained for a new task or dataset, its visual encoder can be frozen and only its action generation module trained, reducing training cost. Freezing removes the encoder's backward pass, but its forward pass must still run at every training step because the input images change, so it keeps consuming GPU compute. We therefore ask whether moving this computation to a low power AI accelerator such as an NPU can reduce total energy despite the added data transfer and longer training time, and how it affects policy performance. We built an asynchronous training pipeline that uses both a GPU and an NPU for the AR-Actor specialist. The frozen visual encoder runs in A8W8 INT8 on a Mobilint Aries2 NPU, while the FP32 action expert is trained on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU. We compared a GPU-only baseline with four conditions, L1 to L4, which gradually extend NPU offloading from one to four Transformer encoder layers. Each condition was trained for 30,000 steps with three random seeds. We measured GPU board power for the GPU-only condition and combined GPU and NPU board power for the NPU conditions. Energy per sample decreased by 17.1% in L1, which offloaded ResNet18 and the first encoder layer, and by 27.9% in L4, which offloaded ResNet18 and all four encoder layers. In contrast, training time per sample increased by 15.2% in L1 and 37.7% in L4, and peak allocated GPU memory decreased by 19.8 to 20.7%. The 15 resulting policies were each evaluated with the same 300 environment seeds, for a total of 4,500 simulator rollouts. The combined success rate was 93.33% for GPU-only and 91.44 to 92.89% for the NPU conditions. These results show that NPU offloading of a frozen visual encoder can reduce training energy, but it increases training time and lowers policy success rate by 0.44 to 1.89 percentage points compared with GPU-only training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在机器人策略训练中，将冻结的视觉编码器卸载到NPU上是否能在增加训练时间的同时降低能耗，并评估其对策略性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉编码器虽可减少反向传播，但前向传播仍消耗GPU计算资源，作者希望探索使用低功耗NPU来降低总能耗。
AI.method: 构建了一个异步训练流水线，GPU训练FP32动作专家，NPU运行INT8冻结视觉编码器，比较GPU-only和四种NPU卸载条件（L1-L4），每种训练30,000步，使用三个随机种子，并测量能耗、时间、内存和策略成功率。
AI.result: L1能耗降低17.1%，L4降低27.9%；训练时间分别增加15.2%和37.7%；GPU内存减少19.8-20.7%；NPU条件成功率比GPU-only低0.44-1.89个百分点（91.44-92.89% vs 93.33%）。
AI.conclusion: NPU卸载冻结视觉编码器可降低训练能耗，但会增加训练时间并轻微降低策略成功率，需在能耗与性能间权衡。

title: ForceU-VLA: A Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Ultrasound Scanning
summary: Embodied intelligent ultrasound scanning enables the automation and standardization of the ultrasound examination process by integrating perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. However, existing methods suffer from loosely coupled modeling between force and ultrasound modalities and lack awareness of scanning stages, which limits their ability to capture dynamic probe-tissue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ForceU-VLA, a force-aware Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous embodied ultrasound scanning, which leverages force signals and ultrasound image feedback throughout the scanning process to enable accurate and high-quality ultrasound acquisition. Firstly, we propose a Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM) that synergistically fuses ultrasound visual and force-feedback information to provide stable, reliable guidance for probe motion. Secondly, a Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM) is proposed to accommodate the task requirements across different scanning stages by adaptively modulating multimodal features to enhance their representation quality. Additionally, we introduce ForceU-VLA-Data, a real-world, force-aware embodied ultrasound dataset that integrates visual, force, and action signals, including data from two organs across five representative clinical scanning views, and comprising 450 expert-collected trajectories with approximately 100,000 synchronized multimodal frames. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that ForceU-VLA significantly improves contact stability and probe pressure regulation in embodied ultrasound scanning, thereby effectively enhancing task execution quality and overall system reliability. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/ForceU-VLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForceU-VLA，一种力感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过协同融合超声图像和力反馈信号，并引入阶段自适应调制机制，显著提升了自主超声扫描的接触稳定性和探头压力调节能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在力与超声模态之间缺乏紧密耦合建模，且未考虑扫描阶段的差异性，导致难以捕捉动态的探头-组织交互，限制了扫描质量。
AI.method: 提出ForceU-VLA模型，包含力-超声协同融合模块（FUSFM）和阶段自适应调制机制（SAMM），并构建了包含视觉、力、动作信号的真实世界数据集ForceU-VLA-Data。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ForceU-VLA在接触稳定性和探头压力调节方面明显改善，有效提升了任务执行质量和系统可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 力感知的视觉-语言-行动模型能够显著提升自主超声扫描性能，该数据集和代码已公开，促进该领域研究。

title: DER Allocation without Load Prediction via Reinforcement Learning
comment: 5 pages. Presented at the 2026 IEEE Power & Energy Society General Meeting (PES GM)
summary: The growing variability of renewable generation increases the need for fast and flexible grid-balancing mechanisms. Existing frameworks for distributed energy resource aggregations (DERAs) rely on short-term forecasts of net demand, making their performance highly sensitive to prediction errors. In this paper we present a forecast-free reinforcement learning (RL) framework for DERA allocation that learns optimal policies directly from operational data. We model the DERA dynamics as a deterministic linear system and the exogenous net load as a feature-based linear Markov process, capturing short-range temporal dependencies without explicit forecasting. We derive a closed-form expression for the optimal policy, which is learned through a least-squares value iteration (LSVI) algorithm using data collected across episodes. The proposed framework preserves the interpretability and constraint satisfaction of DER model while adapting to stochastic demand variations through data-driven updates. Numerical experiments on real California Independent System Operator (CAISO) net-demand data demonstrate that the learned controller achieves high tracking accuracy and stable regulation across heterogeneous DER aggregators without requiring any demand prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无预测的强化学习框架，用于分布式能源聚合器的分配，直接学习最优策略，无需需求预测，并在CAISO数据上验证了高精度和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源的波动性增加，现有DERA框架依赖短期预测，性能受预测误差影响，亟需一种不依赖预测的自适应分配机制。
AI.method: 将DERA建模为确定性线性系统，净负荷视为基于特征的线性马尔可夫过程，推导最优策略的闭式解，并通过最小二乘值迭代（LSVI）算法从历史数据中学习。
AI.result: 在CAISO真实净负荷数据上，所提控制器实现了高跟踪精度和稳定的调节性能，且无需任何需求预测。
AI.conclusion: 该无预测RL框架有效克服了对预测的依赖，同时保留了模型的可解释性和约束满足性，为DERA的鲁棒分配提供了新途径。

title: Braided Vision Transformer for Stroke Detection in Multi-view Retinal Fundus Imaging
summary: Stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, emphasizing the importance of its accurate and immediate assessment. Retinal fundus imaging has emerged as a promising modality for stroke assessment, as the retina reflects cerebrovascular and neurological risk factors. Contrary to conventional neuroimaging techniques, retinal fundus imaging offers a non-invasive, cost-effective, and portable alternative for rapid screening. This paper explores the feasibility of retinal fundus imaging for stroke and transient ischemic attack (TIA) detection using macula-centric and optic nerve head-centric views captured from both eyes. Our study introduces, to the best of our knowledge, the first vision transformer model for retinal fundus imaging in stroke assessment, offering a novel approach for capturing retinal patterns. Thereby, we propose the Braided Vision Transformer (BViT) model, which extracts representative features from the given multi-view images while simultaneously capturing inter-view relationships across both eyes, enabling a more informative understanding of retinal biomarkers associated with cerebrovascular events. Experiments conducted on our collected Stroke-Data dataset demonstrate that BViT achieves an AUC score of 0.75 for stroke detection, outperforming regular vision transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视网膜眼底图像的卒中检测新方法，首次将视觉Transformer应用于该任务，并设计了BViT模型以融合多视角信息，在自建数据集上达到0.75的AUC。
AI.motivation: 卒中是全球致死致残的主要原因，亟需快速准确的评估手段。传统神经影像成本高、便携性差，而视网膜眼底成像作为非侵入性、低成本且可移动的替代方案，具有筛查潜力。
AI.method: 提出Braided Vision Transformer (BViT)模型，利用双眼的多视角（黄斑中心与视盘中心）图像，提取代表性特征并建模跨视角关系，以捕捉与脑血管事件相关的视网膜生物标志物。
AI.result: 在自建的Stroke-Data数据集上，BViT的AUC达到0.75，优于常规视觉Transformer。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜眼底成像结合BViT模型可用于卒中及TIA检测，为快速筛查提供了新途径，但AUC仍表明需进一步改进以提高临床实用性。

title: SKILL: Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent for Logic Optimization
summary: Logic synthesis optimization poses significant challenges due to exponentially growing search spaces, sparse reward signals, and diverse logic structures. Traditional expert-designed flows lack adaptability, while reinforcement learning (RL) methods often suffer from low sample efficiency and limited interpretability. We introduce SKILL, a Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent that unifies multi-agent LLM reasoning and RL-based environment interaction for automated synthesis optimization. SKILL coordinates three specialized LLMs: GPT-4o for strategic planning, Claude Sonnet 4 for detailed reasoning, and Gemini 2.5 Pro for efficient analysis with a PPO-based RL agent that learns actionable policies through direct interaction with synthesis tools. A novel self-correcting module monitors environment feedback (PDA metrics), detects suboptimal behaviors, and invokes LLM-guided recovery strategies. Evaluations on IWLS, OpenCores, and EPFL benchmarks show SKILL achieves a 12.4 % PDA improvement over expert flows and 86.3% success rate on logic systems up to 500K gates.

AI.tldr: SKILL 是一个结合多智能体 LLM 推理与强化学习的自动化逻辑综合优化系统，通过自纠正模块显著提升优化效果。
AI.motivation: 针对逻辑综合优化中搜索空间大、奖励稀疏、结构多样等问题，传统专家流程适应性差，强化学习方法样本效率低且可解释性弱。
AI.method: SKILL 协调三个专用 LLM（GPT-4o 负责策略规划、Claude Sonnet 4 负责详细推理、Gemini 2.5 Pro 负责高效分析）与基于 PPO 的强化学习智能体，通过自纠正模块监控环境反馈（PDA 指标）并触发 LLM 引导的恢复策略。
AI.result: 在 IWLS、OpenCores 和 EPFL 基准上，SKILL 相比专家流程实现 12.4% 的 PDA 改进，对高达 500K 门的逻辑系统成功率达 86.3%。
AI.conclusion: SKILL 结合 LLM 推理与强化学习交互，有效提升逻辑综合优化的性能和成功率，展示了多智能体协同与自纠正机制的优势。

title: Class Imbalance and Batch Effects in LLM-Based Screening for Systematic Reviews
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at ENIAC 2026 (National Meeting on Artificial and Computational Intelligence), part of BRACIS 2026
summary: This study analyses LLMs in imbalanced binary classification, using study screening in systematic reviews as the application domain. An experiment was conducted in five reviews, comparing individual and batch processing, with and without prevalence metadata. The results indicate a limited influence of the prevalence metadata, with no evidence that it improves performance. In contrast, batch processing produced larger behavioral changes that varied according to the prevalence of the class. The aggregate and item-level analyses did not always coincide. Therefore, batch processing should be evaluated not only in terms of cost, but also in relation to its effects on decision-making behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了LLMs在不平衡二分类任务中的表现，以系统综述中的研究筛选为应用场景，发现流行率元数据影响有限，而批处理会导致行为变化且与总体和条目级分析结果不一致。
AI.motivation: 探索LLMs在不平衡分类中的应用，特别是系统综述筛选中的表现，以及流行率信息和批处理对决策行为的影响。
AI.method: 在五个综述中进行实验，比较单独与批处理、有无流行率元数据的条件。
AI.result: 流行率元数据对性能无显著提升，批处理带来更大的行为变化，且受类别流行率影响，总体和条目级分析结果并不总是一致。
AI.conclusion: 批处理不仅应考虑成本，还应评估其对决策行为的影响。

title: MODAL: Multi-Modal Object Re-ID via Model-Driven Sparse Decoupling and Text-Image Differential Filtering
summary: Multi-modal object re-identification (Re-ID) aims to facilitate cross-camera object retrieval in complex environments by leveraging complementary information from visual (e.g., RGB, NIR, TIR) and textual modalities. However, existing approaches often lack principled feature disentanglement and coherent multi-modal integration, leading to entangled representations that introduce cross-modal conflicts, obscure discriminative cues, and suffer distribution shift under modality-missing conditions. To tackle these challenges, we propose MODAL, a novel multi-modal object re-identification framework, grounded in coupled sparse coding theory and differential suppression principles. A core component of MODAL is a Multi-modal Feature Sparse Decoupling module, developed in a model-driven deep unrolling manner based on multi-modal coupled sparse coding. It explicitly decomposes multi-modal features into uni-modal specific, bi-modal and tri-modal shared representations, thereby achieving more transparent and effective feature disentanglement. Benefiting from the principled feature disentanglement, MODAL naturally mitigates performance degradation in incomplete-modality scenarios via a Modality-Aware Subspace Activation that selectively activates only the consistently shared subspaces. Moreover, we propose a Text-Image Differential Filtering module that leverages coarse-grained textual semantics to adaptively suppress task-irrelevant responses in the decoupled visual representations, thereby enhancing discriminative information. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MODAL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior transparency.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于耦合稀疏编码和差分抑制原理的多模态目标重识别框架MODAL，通过模型驱动的深度展开实现特征解耦，并在模态缺失情况下保持性能，达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏特征解耦和一致的多模态融合，导致表示纠缠、跨模态冲突、判别信息模糊以及模态缺失时的分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 设计多模态特征稀疏解耦模块（基于耦合稀疏编码的深度展开），显式分解为单模态、双模态和三模态共享表示；利用模态感知子空间激活在模态缺失时仅激活一致共享子空间；文本-图像差分过滤模块利用文本语义抑制视觉表示中的任务无关响应。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上取得最先进性能，且具有更好的透明性。
AI.conclusion: MODAL通过原理性特征解耦和差分抑制，有效解决了多模态重识别中的关键挑战，验证了模型驱动与数据驱动结合的有效性。

title: Which Question Is Your Attention Metric Answering? Attention Rows as Compositional Data
comment: Preprint under submission
summary: Each row of a transformer's attention matrix is a probability distribution over tokens, and in trained models most of that probability lands on a single \emph{sink} token, usually the first. Standard tools for comparing attention rows (cosine similarity, Jensen--Shannon divergence, Shannon entropy) therefore hinge on a choice papers rarely report: keep the sink, or drop it and renormalize. This choice can reverse conclusions. On ten pretrained models from five families, 17--47% of verdicts about which of two heads is more similar flip with the convention, and the most prominent structure in a standard BERT head-clustering pipeline is an artifact of it. The reason is that one-number summaries mix two questions: how much attention the sink takes, and how the rest is divided among the content tokens. Treating rows as compositional data separates them exactly: the Aitchison distance splits orthogonally into a sink term and a content term, entropy splits by an exact identity, and the content distance is characterized by invariances the transformer itself possesses. The separation matters in practice: most measured entropy collapse during training is the sink growing, not attention sharpening (30% of the drop at 70M parameters, 95% at 1B, 79% at 1.4B), and pruning heads with the wrong channel can inflate perplexity more than a hundredfold.
