Recent 3D-LLMs and 2D-VLMs perform poorly on these tasks, lacking both comparison-centric design and geometric awareness. In contrast, Multi-3DLLM trained on our mixture data learns geometric reasoning, surpasses all baselines on MO3D, and provides positive transfer to single-object classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于多物体3D推理的框架，包含指令数据集MO3D、模型Multi-3DLLM和两个应用基准，显著提升了3D-LLMs的物体间比较与几何理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-LLMs主要处理单物体或场景描述，缺乏详细的跨物体比较能力，且几何感知不足。
AI.method: 构建MO3D指令数据集；提出Multi-3DLLM，采用最小Patch-Interaction Transformer建模物体内/间关系；设计Shape Mating和Change Captioning两个应用基准。
AI.result: Multi-3DLLM在MO3D上超越所有基线，并正向迁移至单物体分类任务。
AI.conclusion: 多物体比较与几何推理可提升3D-LLM性能，且有实际应用价值。

title: UC-PSRO: Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum for Game-Theoretic Course-of-Action Generation in Adversarial Swarms
summary: We study generating game-theoretically optimized Courses of Action (COAs) for a Blue UAS swarm against an adaptive Red adversary in a communication-degraded environment, motivated by (but not derived from) a public U.S. Air Force SBIR solicitation. We propose UC-PSRO (Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum), combining three mechanisms: (i) PSRO self-play, so Blue and Red policies train as approximate best responses to each other rather than one side against a fixed scripted opponent; (ii) FiLM conditioning of the Blue policy on a Commander's-Intent weight vector, sampled from a Dirichlet distribution during training, so one trained policy is re-steerable at execution time without retraining; and (iii) a curriculum annealing communication-graph edge dropout during training, so the swarm learns decentralized, peer-to-peer fallback instead of depending on full connectivity. We evaluate on a synthetic, unclassified stand-in for the solicitation's maritime scenario, with 5 seeds at N=25 Blue agents and a scalability sweep to N=200. We find a genuine trade-off, not a uniform win: the communication-dropout curriculum alone gives the strongest, most robust mission-completion rates of any learned method, improving counter-intuitively as denial increases (35% to 62% success as dropout rises from 0 to 0.75); adding utility-conditioning and PSRO self-play substantially slows convergence within a fixed budget, and we find no reliable exploitability advantage for self-play over a fixed-opponent policy, both statistically indistinguishable from a small, near-zero gap. We report this honestly as a convergence cost not yet offset by a demonstrated robustness benefit, rather than overstating one method as dominant, and provide a fully vectorized, open environment training at N=200 agents in single-digit milliseconds per step on a single consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UC-PSRO方法，结合PSRO自博弈、FiLM条件化和通信丢弃课程，用于生成蓝军无人机群在通信降级环境中的博弈优化行动方案。实验发现通信丢弃课程单独最佳，而效用条件化和自博弈增加了收敛成本但未带来显著鲁棒性提升。
AI.motivation: 受美国空军SBIR征询启发，研究在通信降级环境下蓝军无人机群对抗适应性红方时的行动方案生成，旨在超越固定脚本对手的训练方式，实现策略可重定向和去中心化鲁棒性。
AI.method: 结合三种机制：(i) PSRO自博弈使蓝红策略互为近似最佳响应；(ii) FiLM条件化蓝军策略于指挥官意图权重向量（训练时从Dirichlet分布采样），实现执行时无需重训练即可重定向；(iii) 课程学习退火通信图边丢弃率，训练去中心化点对点备份。环境为合成非机密海事场景，支持大规模训练。
AI.result: 通信丢弃课程单独使任务完成率随丢弃率上升（0→0.75时从35%增至62%）；效用条件化和自博弈显著减慢收敛，且自博弈相对固定对手无可靠优势（统计上无显著差异）。
AI.conclusion: 通信丢弃课程提供最强鲁棒性，但效用条件化与自博弈带来收敛成本且未体现收益，应诚实报告为权衡而非宣称单一方法占优。提供开源向量化环境，支持N=200在单GPU上快速训练。

title: EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input
comment: 16 pages. Accepted at the WearableAI Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Archival Track)
summary: The use of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding with wearable devices is constrained by the token budget. Memory and compute cost scale with the number of visual tokens, and high-resolution video quickly becomes expensive to transmit and process at scale. Prior work (GazeLLM) addresses this by cropping the video around the camera wearer's gaze. This reduces the number of visual tokens by about tenfold while maintaining or improving the quality of full-resolution descriptions. However, this compression strategy depends on dedicated eye-tracking hardware, which is unavailable on consumer smart glasses. Building a software-only substitute poses a joint constraint: the predictor must be accurate enough to preserve downstream description quality, yet light enough to run on-device, within the power and compute budget of a smartphone. We address this with EgoGazeLite, a lightweight dual-process gaze predictor for egocentric video. Across two MLLMs, three automated metrics, and two LLM judges, predicted-gaze crops show no significant difference from ground-truth-gaze crops. Equivalence is confirmed in all ten cases. EgoGazeLite achieves this at 15.7M parameters, 6.71 GFLOPs, and runs the full gaze-and-crop pipeline end-to-end in real time (21.6 ms/frame) on consumer accelerator hardware. Together, these results remove the need for eye-tracking hardware for token-efficient, gaze-conditioned egocentric video understanding with MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoGazeLite，一种无需眼动追踪硬件的轻量级凝视预测器，用于在智能眼镜上进行ego视频理解。它通过软件预测凝视区域并进行裁剪，显著减少视觉token数量，同时保持MLLM描述质量，实现了实时端到端处理。
AI.motivation: 依赖专用眼动追踪硬件（如GazeLLM）进行视频裁剪以减少token，但消费级智能眼镜缺乏此类硬件。需要一种软件替代方案，既准确又轻量，能在智能手机等设备上实时运行，以支持token高效的ego视频理解。
AI.method: 提出EgoGazeLite，一个双过程凝视预测器（轻量级+精确级），用于预测ego视频中的凝视点，并据此裁剪视频区域。在多种MLLM和指标下评估，并与真实凝视裁剪对比，同时部署在消费级加速器上测试实时性。
AI.result: EgoGazeLite在15.7M参数和6.71 GFLOPs下，预测凝视裁剪与真实凝视裁剪在10个案例（2种MLLM × 3种自动指标 + 2种LLM评判）中均无显著差异（等价性确认），且端到端处理速度达21.6ms/帧，满足实时要求。
AI.conclusion: EgoGazeLite能够替代专用眼动追踪硬件，为凝视条件化的token高效ego视频理解提供软件解决方案，在保持描述质量的同时降低计算和内存开销，适用于消费级智能穿戴设备。

title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
summary: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case study on Spider, comparing 8B open-source backbones with and without chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision against few-shot DeepSeek~V3 and GLM-4 baselines. Four patterns emerge: Spider gains transfer unevenly to BIRD and Spider~2.0; autonomy buys robustness at non-trivial cost; reasoning internalization sits between answer-only decoding and externally orchestrated agents; and CoT gains concentrate on Hard and Extra-Hard queries. We release a Python harness mirroring the autonomy axis so that future methods can be added directly to the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM-based Text-to-SQL领域重新定义为排行榜聚合问题，并提出了一个基于推理自主性轴的组织框架，并通过案例研究揭示了不同方法在基准间的迁移性、成本与鲁棒性权衡等关键模式。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL研究在异构的基准、骨干网络和推理协议下报告结果，导致跨系统比较不可靠，需要进行统一的组织和评估。
AI.method: 论文收集作者报告的指标，按推理自主性轴（约束生成、上下文学习、迭代、智能体、推理内化）组织，并带有可追溯来源。同时，开展Spider案例研究，比较8B开源模型（有无CoT监督）与DeepSeek-V3和GLM-4基线，并发布Python工具包支持未来方法集成。
AI.result: 发现Spider上的收益在BIRD和Spider 2.0上迁移不均；自主性提升鲁棒性但成本较高；推理内化介于答案解码和外部智能体之间；CoT增益集中在Hard和Extra-Hard查询上。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个新的评估框架和工具，为未来Text-to-SQL方法提供更可靠、可扩展的比较平台，并揭示了不同自主性级别方法的性能特征。

title: Propaganda Forensics: Recovering the Generation Pipeline of an AI-Driven Influence Campaign
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 10th Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH), EMNLP 2026
summary: We present a forensic analysis of the generation pipeline behind a recent AI-driven influence campaign. We introduce PROPAGIA, a corpus of 2,646 propagandist French articles from the Storm-1516/CopyCop campaign disclosed by VIGINUM and INSIKT GROUP in 2025. For comparison, we rely on SIPA, a corpus of human-written French mainstream press from the same period. Using topic modeling, vagueness and sentiment analysis, we first isolate persuasion techniques characteristic of propaganda, with PROPAGIA far exceeding SIPA in vagueness, subjectivity and negativity, and citing fewer sources. We then find prompt instruction leaks on 50 of the 84 PROPAGIA websites, including a verbatim ten-point editorial specification accounting for several of these differences, together with high cross-article redundancy. Finally, we show that rewriting-based detection supports INSIKT GROUP's attribution to the Llama 3 family, but also suggests the involvement of Mistral-family models.

AI.tldr: 本文对AI驱动的法国影响力行动Storm-1516/CopyCop进行了取证分析，构建了PROPAGIA语料库，并发现AI生成内容在模糊性、主观性、负面性和低引用率上显著高于人类写作，同时通过提示词泄露和重写检测揭示了模型来源。
AI.motivation: 近期出现利用AI生成宣传内容进行影响力行动的现象，但缺乏对生成流程和内容的系统取证分析，需要理解其技术特征与归属。
AI.method: 构建PROPAGIA语料库（2,646篇法文宣传文章）与SIPA对照语料，运用主题建模、模糊性分析、情感分析和引用分析；检测站内提示词泄露；采用基于重写的检测方法推断模型归属。
AI.result: PROPAGIA在模糊性、主观性和负面性上远超SIPA，引用源更少；84个网站中50个存在提示词泄露，包括十点编辑规范；检测支持Llama 3归因，但提示Mistral系列也可能涉及。
AI.conclusion: AI生成宣传可被系统化识别，提示词泄露和风格差异是关键指标，且模型归属需考虑多源可能性。

title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving
summary: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model make complementary errors, and an oracle choice between their answers recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model. Based on this observation, we propose KV-Rescue, a training-free inference framework that bridges the information gap introduced by KV eviction using a lightweight full-context helper. KV-Rescue interleaves reasoning steps from the two models into a shared trajectory. An online detector uses entropy and compressibility to terminate the generation of incoherent or repetitive base-model candidates early. Across five math benchmarks with Qwen2.5-Math 7B and 72B, KV-Rescue recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64. A decode-cost analysis further shows that preventing runaway degeneration cuts base-model token generation by 43% on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KV-Rescue，一种无需训练的推理框架，通过轻量级全上下文辅助模型弥补KV缓存驱逐导致的信息缺失，显著恢复精度并防止退化生成。
AI.motivation: KV缓存驱逐虽降低内存成本，但导致信息丢失，尤其在激进预算下引起精度下降和生成退化。作者发现大部分损失源于信息缺口而非能力缺口，因此希望借助外部辅助模型弥补该缺口。
AI.method: KV-Rescue框架交替使用被驱逐的主模型和全上下文的辅助模型，共享推理轨迹；在线检测器基于熵和可压缩性提前终止不连贯或重复的生成候选。
AI.result: 在五个数学基准上（Qwen2.5-Math 7B和72B），预算B=64时平均恢复87%的精度损失；同时减少主模型43%的token生成，避免退化。
AI.conclusion: KV-Rescue有效弥补KV驱逐的信息缺口，提升精度和稳定性，且无需额外训练，为长推理场景提供实用方案。

title: Hierarchical Adaptive Feature Refinement Network for VHR Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS). Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/anticipate218/HAFRNet
summary: Semantic segmentation of very-high-resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery increasingly benefits from strong pretrained hierarchical encoders, yet exploiting their multi-stage representations remains difficult. Nearby regions demand different balances between fine detail and semantic context, aggressive task-specific transformations perturb useful pretrained features, and conventional semantic supervision provides limited structural guidance. We present HAFR-Net, a progressive refinement framework that adaptively organizes and conservatively refines hierarchical representations instead of replacing them with a monolithic decoder transformation. Heterogeneity-Guided Stage-Adaptive Fusion (HG-SAF) predicts dense stage weights conditioned on local feature variation. A Frequency-Residual Adapter (FRA) then injects frequency information through a bounded, zero-initialized residual branch that keeps the fused representation as its reference. A Confusion-Aware Tri-Prior Decoder (CATP) finally regularizes the prediction with boundary, objectness, and training-derived class-relation cues. Under a matched Swin-B training and single-scale inference protocol, HAFR-Net attains 84.12%, 87.86%, 55.17%, and 67.70% mIoU on ISPRS Vaihingen, ISPRS Potsdam, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap, improving the matched UPerNet baseline by 0.55, 0.95, 1.55, and 1.84 percentage points, respectively. Controlled analyses further show consistent spatial reweighting beyond content-only routing, improved boundary and thin-structure accuracy over matched spatial and spectral alternatives, and reduced confusion on pre-declared class pairs.

AI.tldr: HAFR-Net 通过异质性引导的阶段自适应融合、频率残差适配器和混淆感知三先验解码器，渐进式地精细化层级特征，在多个 VHR 遥感分割基准上显著优于匹配的 UPerNet 基线。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率遥感图像语义分割受益于预训练层级编码器，但多阶段表示的有效利用仍具挑战：不同区域需要不同的细节与语义平衡，激进的任务特定变换会破坏预训练特征，且常规语义监督缺乏结构引导。
AI.method: 提出 HAFR-Net，包含异质性引导阶段自适应融合（HG-SAF）动态预测密集阶段权重，频率残差适配器（FRA）通过有界零初始化残差分支注入频率信息，以及混淆感知三先验解码器（CATP）利用边界、目标性和类别关系先验进行正则化。
AI.result: 在 Swin-B 和单尺度推理下，HAFR-Net 在 ISPRS Vaihingen、Potsdam、LoveDA 和 OpenEarthMap 上分别达到 84.12%、87.86%、55.17% 和 67.70% mIoU，较匹配的 UPerNet 基线分别提升 0.55、0.95、1.55 和 1.84 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: HAFR-Net 验证了保守地细化和自适应组织层级表示的有效性，优于内容路由、空间光谱替代方案，并减少了预定义类对的混淆，为 VHR 遥感分割提供了新思路。

title: Scalable Black-Box Model Attribution for Images
comment: Project page: https://asaf-livne.github.io/RPA/
summary: The rapid proliferation of generative models raises the model attribution problem: given only an image, can we determine which model produced it? Existing methods have grown as elaborate as the generators they target, on the as- sumption that a more sophisticated model demands a more sophisticated attributor. We show it does not. RPA (Raw- Patch Attribution) attributes images in the strictest black- box setting with a lightweight CNN. Despite its simplicity, it attributes more models at higher accuracy than prior work, reaching 98.0% on 25-class DRAGON and 92.9% on 27- class OpenFake; it is data-efficient and runs at a cost inde- pendent of the number of candidate models; and it stays ro- bust to the compression, blur, and resizing images undergo in the wild. Training for closed-set attribution yields a ver- satile feature extractor: the same representation recovers model lineage without supervision, flags and groups unseen generators, and admits new models through few-shot adap- tation rather than retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级CNN方法RPA，用于黑盒场景下的图像模型归属判定，在多个基准上达到了最高精度，且具有数据高效性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型的归属方法过于复杂，作者质疑是否需要如此复杂的模型，并探索简单方法是否同样有效。
AI.method: RPA方法使用轻量级CNN直接处理原始图像块（raw patches），在严格黑盒设置下进行归属判定，不依赖候选模型的内部信息。
AI.result: 在25类DRAGON数据集上达到98.0%准确率，在27类OpenFake数据集上达到92.9%，优于现有方法；对压缩、模糊、缩放等干扰鲁棒，且训练成本与候选模型数量无关。
AI.conclusion: 闭集训练得到的特征具有通用性，可用于无监督的模型溯源、未知生成模型的识别与分组，并可通过少量样本适应新模型，无需重新训练。

title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables and accepted in North American Power Symposium 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM)-assisted energy-management tools can translate natural-language context into structured grid commands, but syntactic validity does not imply physical admissibility. This paper presents TwinGridShield, a model-independent runtime authorization layer that evaluates each proposed action in a deterministic network twin before release. The prototype checks connectivity, branch-flow, generator, and load-shedding invariants and records each decision in a hash-chained log. A controlled IEEE 14-bus study evaluates single-step switching, redispatch, and load-shedding actions using DC power flow and experimentally assigned branch ratings. In the matched-model experiment, a stochastic proposal source configured to select an unsafe action with probability p=0.84 produced 421 unsafe proposals in 500 attacked-condition trials, a realized rate of 84.2%. This value characterizes the configured surrogate and is not an empirical measurement of LLM prompt-injection susceptibility. TwinGridShield produced 0 unsafe releases in those 500 trials. Because action labeling and authorization used the same DC model, system state, branch ratings, and encoded constraints, this result verifies conformance of the implementation to its encoded authorization predicate rather than safety under model error. The principal robustness evaluation therefore introduces model mismatch. Unsafe acceptance reached 5.63% under bounded +20% and -20% per-bus load-measurement error and 30.09% when actual branch ratings were 20% below modeled ratings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TwinGridShield，一个模型无关的运行时授权层，在确定性网络孪生中验证LLM生成的电网动作，确保物理可行性。在IEEE 14节点测试中，该原型在500次攻击试验中实现了0次不安全释放，但在模型失配下（如负荷测量误差或支路额定值偏差）不安全接受率分别达5.63%和30.09%。
AI.motivation: LLM辅助能源管理工具生成的命令虽语法正确，但可能违反物理约束，导致电网不安全运行。现有方法未充分验证动作的物理可行性，亟需一种独立于LLM的运行时安全机制。
AI.method: TwinGridShield使用确定性网络孪生对每个提议动作进行实时评估，检查连通性、支路潮流、发电机和甩负荷等不变量，并采用哈希链日志记录决策。实验基于IEEE 14节点系统，使用直流潮流和实验分配的支路额定值，通过随机提案源模拟不安全动作，并引入模型失配进行鲁棒性评估。
AI.result: 在匹配模型实验中，随机源以84.2%的概率生成不安全动作（421/500），但TwinGridShield全部阻止（0次不安全释放）。在模型失配下，当负荷测量误差为±20%时不安全接受率升至5.63%，当实际支路额定值低于模型值20%时升至30.09%。
AI.conclusion: TwinGridShield在模型准确时能有效阻止不安全动作，但其安全保证依赖于模型精度。模型失配显著削弱其防护能力，提示实际部署需考虑模型不确定性或引入更鲁棒的验证机制。

title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Code, frozen protocols, raw artifacts, and analysis are available at https://github.com/Madhumasa84/MATS-multilingual-reasoning-monitorability
summary: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a potentially useful safety signal, but its reliability across languages and behavioral settings remains uncertain. In a small case study of eight manually verified synthetic scenarios, one model, one annotator, and one deterministic generation seed, I study API-visible reasoning during indirect prompt injection in Sarvam-105B across English, Tamil, and Tanglish. A four scenario pilot found 5/12 injected attack successes without reasoning and 1/11 with reasoning. A preregistered four-scenario follow-up reversed that direction, finding 2/12 attacks without reasoning and 3/12 with reasoning. With only four scenarios per phase, this design cannot distinguish a real reasoning-mode effect from prompt-specific variation or sampling noise. Across 20 non-empty injected-thinking traces, all 17 benign-correct outputs stated an intent to ignore the injection, while all three attack successes stated an intent to follow it. These descriptive observations provide a reproducible case study of behaviorally informative visible reasoning when it is available; they do not establish that reasoning mode improves safety, that visible reasoning is mechanistically faithful, or that the findings generalize beyond this configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过小型案例研究，探讨了可见推理在跨语言间接提示注入中的安全信号可靠性，发现推理模式对攻击成功率的影响不稳定，但推理内容与行为结果相关。
AI.motivation: 链式推理监控作为安全信号具有潜力，但其跨语言和行为设置中的可靠性未知，需要实证检验。
AI.method: 使用Sarvam-105B模型，在英语、泰米尔语和Tanglish三种语言下，对八个手工验证的合成场景进行间接提示注入测试，比较有无推理模式下的攻击成功率，并分析推理痕迹。
AI.result: 试点发现无推理时5/12攻击成功，有推理时1/11成功；预注册后续测试则反转（2/12对3/12）。所有良性输出均表明忽略注入，而所有攻击成功案例均表明遵循注入。
AI.conclusion: 可见推理在可用时提供行为信息，但推理模式是否提升安全性、推理是否忠实机制以及结果是否普适，尚不明确。

title: Schema-Agnostic Graph Reasoning Agent for Hybrid Knowledge Graphs
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents navigate unfamiliar codebases with a handful of generic primitives for listing, reading and searching files (ls, cat, grep). A knowledge graph admits the same interface: listing neighbours, reading node content and searching descriptions are the same operations on a different substrate. Building on this correspondence, we present GRA, a Graph Reasoning Agent that explores hybrid knowledge graphs, whose nodes are either textual concepts or relational tables, with seven generic tools, discovering everything domain-specific at run time. On UFK-M (Unified Factory Knowledge Model), an industrial benchmark of 258 analytical questions whose gold answers are produced by executing validated SQL programs, GRA beats a full-context agent by 5.1 pp (88.4% vs. 83.3%), while reading under a third of its input tokens. A graph-free control shows the gain comes chiefly from selective agentic access rather than graph topology, and that the effect depends on a model able to drive tools reliably. Seeing less, the agent answers better: selective navigation over a structured substrate beats exhaustive context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图推理智能体GRA，通过统一工具接口探索混合知识图谱，在工业基准UFK-M上以更少输入令牌超越全上下文智能体，证明选择性导航优于穷举上下文。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型LLM智能体在陌生代码库中依赖通用原语，而知识图谱提供相同接口。作者探索利用该对应关系，通过选择性访问结构化知识图谱提升问答性能并减少上下文消耗。
AI.method: 构建混合知识图谱（节点为文本概念或关系表），使用七个通用工具（如列表、读取、搜索）进行运行时探索。在UFK-M基准上比较GRA与全上下文智能体及无图控制。
AI.result: GRA在UFK-M上准确率88.4% vs 83.3%（提升5.1个百分点），输入令牌减少三分之二。无图控制显示增益主要来自选择性智能体访问而非图拓扑，且依赖模型驱动工具的能力。
AI.conclusion: 选择性导航结构化子图比穷举上下文更有效，支持“看得少答得更好”的观点；图拓扑本身贡献有限，工具可靠性是关键。

title: Gaussian-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for 3D Gaussian Splats
comment: Joint-embedding predictive representation learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) represents 3D content with anisotropic primitives that jointly encode geometry and appearance. Fixed-budget encoders consume sampled observations of Gaussian assets, so the same object may be observed through different primitive realizations. Existing self-supervised methods mainly reconstruct masked Gaussian attributes, tying supervision to one sampled realization and requiring an input-space decoder. Latent prediction offers an alternative, but its application to Gaussian tokens requires targets that accommodate coupled attributes and heterogeneous spatial support. We introduce Gaussian-JEPA, which predicts representations of held-out Gaussian token blocks from visible context. An online encoder processes the context, while a shared exponential-moving-average encoder supplies stop-gradient features for multi-scale targets. Complementary target projections and feature-space grounding provide latent supervision without reconstructing Gaussian attributes. We evaluate the features under Gaussian resampling, partial observations, and renderable shape completion, together with transfer to part segmentation and object classification. Compared with matched reconstruction pretraining, Gaussian-JEPA is more consistent across resampled inputs, retains more instance information under partial observations, and provides stronger frozen features for Gaussian completion. These results support latent prediction as an effective objective for reusable 3D Gaussian representations. Code is on the project page (https://amazingren.github.io/Gaussian-JEPA/).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gaussian-JEPA，一种基于潜在预测的自监督方法，用于学习3D高斯溅射的可复用表示，通过预测掩蔽高斯令牌的表示而非重建属性，在重采样、部分观测等条件下表现出更强的鲁棒性和迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督方法主要重建掩蔽高斯属性，但这依赖于单一采样的实现，且需要输入空间解码器；潜在预测目标需要适应耦合属性和异质空间支持，尚未被有效应用于高斯令牌。
AI.method: 采用在线编码器处理可见上下文，共享指数移动平均编码器提供多尺度目标的停止梯度特征，通过互补目标投影和特征空间接地进行潜在监督，而非重建高斯属性。
AI.result: 与匹配的重建预训练相比，Gaussian-JEPA在重采样输入下更一致，部分观测下保留更多实例信息，并为高斯补全提供更强的冻结特征；在部件分割和对象分类任务上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 潜在预测是学习可复用3D高斯表示的有效目标，支持跨采样和部分观测的鲁棒特征学习。

title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, IVT predicts latent representations of future frames together with the target textual answer, encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent. At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames. We conduct controlled studies across target representations, decoder designs, prediction horizons, data mixtures, training curricula, and predictive objectives. IVT improves over direct-answer fine-tuning on all six evaluation settings while retaining the same inference pathway. Compared with explicit Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces average end-to-end latency by more than 5x. Together, our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in visual chain-of-thought, may not be necessary for effective proactive video reasoning. Predictive world modeling can be internalized during training to produce multimodal reasoners that are both more accurate and substantially more efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出内部化视觉思维（IVT）框架，通过在训练时预测未来帧的潜在表示和文本答案，使多模态大语言模型在推理时无需生成中间图像即可进行视觉推理，性能与显式视觉思维链相当，但延迟降低5倍以上。
AI.motivation: 显式视觉思维链在推理时生成中间推理图像，虽然直观但引入大量推理开销，阻碍了在主动视频推理中的应用，因此需要一种在训练时内化视觉推理、推理时直接生成答案的方法。
AI.method: IVT是一种后训练框架，在无标注视频上联合优化文本预测和下一嵌入预测，模型根据部分视频预测未来帧的潜在表示和文本答案，推理时不生成或重新编码未来帧。
AI.result: IVT在六个评估设置上均优于直接答案微调，且与显式视觉思维链性能相当或更好，平均端到端延迟降低5倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 推理时显式像素空间生成（如视觉思维链）并非主动视频推理的必要条件，预测性世界建模可在训练中内化，从而得到更准确且高效的推理模型。

title: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Charles Courchaine and Ricky J. Sethi contributed equally. Demo and code: https://research.sethi.org/metacognition/
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are notorious for struggling with assessing their own uncertainty, detecting knowledge conflicts, or recognizing when problems exceed their expertise; such limitations inevitably undermine reliability and trust in LLMs. In this paper, we present the first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs that addresses these challenges through explicit monitoring and control mechanisms.
  Our system computes a Metacognitive State Vector (MSV) quantifying self-awareness for monitoring across five dimensions derived from cognitive psychology: Emotional Response, Correctness Evaluation, Experiential Match, Conflicting Information, and Problem Importance. MSV values also provide self-regulation for control, automatically switching between System 1 (fast, single- or multi-node) and System 2 (deliberative, multi-node) processing based on query complexity. For System 2 execution, graph-theoretic algorithms control the assignment of specialized roles (Domain Expert, Critic, Evaluator, Synthesizer, and Generalist) to ensemble nodes according to their MSV-quantified metacognitive states.
  Our implementation allows users to explore how different query types trigger distinct processing modes. The Proof-of-Concept (PoC) demo showcases the framework with illustrative examples showing appropriate System 1/System 2 routing and helps visualize the metacognitive process via real-time radar charts and decision indicators. This PoC implementation demonstrates the feasibility of creating a framework for metacognitive self-awareness and self-regulation in LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向LLM集成系统的元认知框架，通过显式监控和控制机制，利用元认知状态向量（MSV）量化自我意识，并自动在系统1（快速处理）和系统2（深思熟虑处理）之间切换，以提升LLM的可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM在使用中难以评估自身不确定性、检测知识冲突或识别超出专业范围的问题，这严重影响了其可靠性和可信度。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于元认知框架的LLM集成系统，计算包含五个维度（情绪反应、正确性评估、经验匹配、冲突信息、问题重要性）的元认知状态向量（MSV），用于监控和自我调节，通过图论算法分配节点角色，并根据查询复杂度自动切换系统1或系统2处理。
AI.result: 通过概念验证（PoC）演示，展示了不同查询类型触发不同处理模式，系统1/系统2路由适当，并通过实时雷达图和决策指标可视化元认知过程，证明了该框架在LLM系统中实现元认知自我意识和自我调节的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该元认知框架为LLM系统提供了自我监控和自我调节的机制，增强了可靠性和可信度，为未来开发更智能的LLM系统奠定了基础。

title: A survey of AI-generated voices and their detection
summary: The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) models to generate highly realistic human voices has advanced rapidly. These technologies power accessibility tools, virtual assistants and creative applications, but they also enable harmful uses, including impersonation, fraud and disinformation. Recent incidents of voice cloning scams targeting businesses and political leaders underscore the urgent need for robust safeguards. Unlike image and video deepfakes, the detection of synthetic voices poses unique challenges due to the complexity of phonetics, prosody and auditory perception. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of AI voice generation and detection methods, encompassing both the technical foundations and the latest state-of-the-art advances. This study also identifies key open challenges, benchmark resources and future directions to make this survey useful for future researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI语音生成与检测技术，涵盖技术基础、最新进展、开放挑战及未来方向，强调应对语音伪造危害的紧迫性。
AI.motivation: AI生成逼真人声的技术进步带来便利，但也引发冒充、欺诈和虚假信息等风险，而语音检测面临独特挑战，亟需系统梳理。
AI.method: 通过全面调查，综述语音生成与检测方法，分析技术原理，并汇总基准资源和开放问题。
AI.result: 总结了当前技术现状，指出关键挑战和基准资源，为未来研究提供了方向。
AI.conclusion: 语音检测复杂且重要，未来需发展更鲁棒的检测方法，并加强基准建设。

title: WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations
summary: Learning to generate or reconstruct explorable worlds requires video paired with more than RGB: camera motion, scene geometry, temporal correspondence and, for interactive models, control signals. Real capture can provide some of these signals, but dense geometry and long-range correspondence usually rely on estimation or specialised instrumentation. Rendering provides these quantities directly, yet existing synthetic resources rarely combine them on the same frames while also supporting controlled changes of viewpoint and appearance. We introduce WorldRover, a data engine for generating richly annotated, long-range explorations of artist-built environments. At its core, WorldRover-Engine is an Unreal Engine pipeline that executes and offline-renders minute-scale routes while preserving their full trajectories and scene geometry. The same exploration can be replayed from first-person, third-person, and 360 panoramic cameras under different environmental states. Using WorldRover-Engine, we construct WorldRover-10M, whose sequences pair RGB with metric depth, camera trajectories, and trajectory-derived action signals throughout each exploration. Third-person subsets additionally provide dense optical flow, long-range 2D/3D point tracks with visibility, and a character trajectory distinct from the camera trajectory. The engine can render a traversal from first-person, third-person and 360 panoramic viewpoints, under different environmental states or with a neutral white material, while preserving the route and scene geometry. WorldRover therefore turns long-horizon world exploration into a scalable data-generation problem, providing supervision for models that must build, maintain, and revisit coherent representations of an explorable world.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 WorldRover，一个用于生成大规模、丰富标注的长时间世界探索数据引擎，提供 RGB、深度、相机轨迹、动作信号、光流和点轨迹等监督信号，以支持可探索世界的生成与重建。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据缺乏几何、对应和控制信号的组合，而真实采集难以获得密集几何和长程对应，合成数据通常不共享这些信号且不支持视点和外观变化。
AI.method: 基于 Unreal Engine 的离线渲染管线，执行分钟级路径并保全程轨迹和场景几何，可重放第一、第三人称和 360 全景相机，并支持不同环境状态和中性材质；构建 WorldRover-10M 数据集。
AI.result: WorldRover-10M 提供 RGB、度量深度、相机轨迹、动作信号、密集光流、长程 2D/3D 点轨迹和人物轨迹，支持多种相机和外观变化。
AI.conclusion: WorldRover 将长时间世界探索转化为可扩展的数据生成问题，为需要构建、维护和回访连贯世界表示的模型提供监督。

title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent-OPD，一种通过轨迹级潜在蒸馏增强视频推理大模型蒸馏的方法，在六个基准上超越仅输出蒸馏，尤其适用于帧数有限或长视频场景。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型视频推理计算成本高昂，促使将推理能力蒸馏到小模型；现有输出级蒸馏（如OPD）未直接约束推理过程中的潜在表示，限制了复杂证据聚合任务的效果。
AI.method: 提出Latent-OPD，在OPD基础上增加轨迹级潜在蒸馏，聚焦每段轨迹末端隐藏状态；并引入渐进式教师前瞻策略，将学生中后层与教师更深层对齐。
AI.result: 在六个视频推理基准上，Latent-OPD一致优于仅输出蒸馏的OPD，尤其在帧数有限、长视频或需复杂证据聚合的任务中提升显著。
AI.conclusion: Latent-OPD是一种高效的帧效率视频推理蒸馏方法，证明了潜在蒸馏在视频推理中的有效性。

title: BASeg: Boundary-Aware Remote Sensing Segmentation with Structural Penalties
summary: Semantic segmentation is a core computer vision task in the remote sensing field, accelerating advancements in ur- ban development, agriculture, ecology, water resources, and environmental monitoring. However, recent methods usually struggle to capture fine-grained object features and bound- ary details. Besides, current widely used datasets often lack city morphology diversity and segmentation on generative im- ages remains largely unexplored. To address these issues, we propose a Mahalanobis-Angle Boundary Loss (MABL) that explicitly enhances boundary and shape consistency. MABL jointly models structural importance and boundary orientation through Mahalanobis distance-based weighting and angle- aware penalty. It can be readily integrated into diverse seg- mentation architectures and consistently improves their accu- racy. Built upon MABL, we introduce BASeg, a boundary- aware remote sensing segmentation framework with Struc- tural Penalties. BASeg integrates a Global Visual State Space module (GSM) with a Cross-Feature Fusion module (CFM) to capture both long-range contextual dependencies and fine- grained local details. Additionally, we establish a global 10- city benchmark dataset (GCD-25k) to facilitate accurate build- ing and road segmentation. Extensive experiments on four remote-sensing benchmarks demonstrate that BASeg consis- tently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to a 2.8% improvement in mIoU while producing more accurate object boundary segmentation across diverse scenes. Moreover, integrating MABL into multiple existing segmentation archi- tectures consistently improves performance across datasets, demonstrating its robustness and broad applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于马氏距离和角度感知的边界损失函数（MABL），并构建了边界感知分割框架BASeg及全球10城市基准数据集GCD-25k，在遥感语义分割中显著提升了边界精度和整体性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感语义分割方法难以捕捉细粒度物体特征和边界细节，且公开数据集缺乏城市形态多样性，对生成图像的分割研究不足。
AI.method: 提出MABL损失（结合马氏距离加权和角度惩罚）及BASeg框架（含全局视觉状态空间模块GSM和跨特征融合模块CFM），并构建GCD-25k数据集。
AI.result: 在四个遥感基准上，BASeg比现有方法mIoU最高提升2.8%，且MABL可集成到多种分割架构中稳定提升性能。
AI.conclusion: MABL和BASeg有效改善了遥感分割的边界质量，GCD-25k促进多样化场景下的研究，方法具有鲁棒性和广泛适用性。

title: OTel: Building Domain-Specialized Telecom LLM Foundations for Intelligent Networks
comment: Accepted at the ACM AI Leadership Summit, Breakthrough Impact Highlights Track, 2026
summary: Frontier AI models have advanced rapidly, but they still struggle with telecom-specific tasks. We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource with derived datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, plus 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines across embedding, reranking, and language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times, and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.5% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.952 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 88.2%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Open Telco (OTel)，一个面向电信领域的开放 AI 资源，包含数据集、30 个全参数微调模型，显著提升了检索、重排和语言模型性能，并获得了社区广泛采用。
AI.motivation: 前沿 AI 模型在通用任务上表现优异，但在电信领域特定任务上仍有不足，缺乏统一、可复现的开源资源。
AI.method: 构建了统一的电信 AI 资源，包括检索、重排、指令微调和安全/弃权数据集，并对嵌入、重排和语言模型进行全参数后训练。
AI.result: OTel 后训练显著提升性能：嵌入检索 NDCG@10 达 93.5%，重排 MRR@10 达 0.952，语言模型正确率达 88.2%；模型下载超 1600 万次，媒体覆盖超 157 次。
AI.conclusion: OTel 作为可复现的电信 AI 基础设施，为社区提供了扩展数据、改进模型的基础，鼓励进一步构建更强的电信领域模型。

title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables
summary: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof sketches. However, it is particularly challenging due to misalignment of formal proof tactics and natural language reasoning. In this work, we rigorously describe a set of five necessary conditions a faithful formal proof must satisfy, and introduce Pistis, an agentic, oracle-guided proof search that produces formal Lean proofs that satisfy them. At its core is a novel faithfulness-preserving divide-and-conquer search, which we name OrderDecompose, that tracks citation dependencies and blocks unfaithful shortcuts, paired with a refutation search, that surfaces gaps and errors in the natural language proof source. OrderDecompose completes proofs that baselines cannot close even within a 12-hour budget, and its artifacts compile over 33$\times$ as fast as prior work's. We apply Pistis on the first three books of Euclid's Elements, producing high-quality artifacts containing faithful formal proofs. Under a blinded human study and an LLM-as-a-judge protocol on rigorous rubrics, Pistis-generated proofs are favored over prior works--2.89$\times$ and 5.2$\times$ as often by human reviewers and the LLM judge, respectively. It further uncovers gaps in Euclid's proofs and their translation, and can accept or refute natural language proofs written by humans or AI, demonstrating that faithful formalization is useful as a proof-checking tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Pistis的智能体框架，用于生成忠实于自然语言推理的正式证明，并引入OrderDecompose搜索方法，在欧几里得《几何原本》前三卷上验证了其效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动形式化与证明搜索虽然能生成编译通过的证明，但往往不忠实于自然语言论证的推理过程，难以用于检查人类或AI的推理。
AI.method: 提出了五个忠实性必要条件，并设计了Pistis框架，核心是OrderDecompose分治搜索，跟踪引用依赖并阻止不忠实捷径，同时结合反驳搜索来发现自然语言证明中的漏洞。
AI.result: OrderDecompose能完成基线无法在12小时内完成的证明，且编译速度快33倍以上；在人类研究和LLM评估中，Pistis生成的证明分别以2.89倍和5.2倍的频率被更偏好，并成功发现了《几何原本》证明中的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的正式化可用于证明检查，帮助人类和AI验证自然语言证明的正确性。

title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and analysis artefacts: https://github.com/parsa-mz/crtitxer
summary: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9 to 25% reduction relative to that control. The direction contradicts what the accumulated-message literature predicts: an episode whose audit reported an error lowers false alarms further still, at all five wordings on the model where that manipulation lands cleanly, though a negativity asymmetry predicts more flagging. Decomposing the episode finds repair content and audit verdict complementary: different components carry the effect on different model families. Signal-detection analysis locates the change in the threshold rather than in discrimination -- the criterion moves in 15 of 15 combinations and survives correction in 13 while d' survives in none, though the d' test is half as sensitive by construction -- and a hand audit of 50 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong, so at this operating point the shift need not be harmful. With reasoning enabled the effect keeps its relative size on both models tested, and the threshold reading holds there too.

AI.tldr: 在自动检查流水线中，先完成一次审计-修复对话会降低语言模型检查器的误报率，效果在15种模型与措辞组合中一致，且信号检测分析表明变化源于判断阈值而非判别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自动检查流程常让一个语言模型检查、另一个修复，但先前研究多关注累积消息对模型的影响，未探究一次审计-修复经历如何影响检查器后续的报告行为。
AI.method: 使用人工验证正确的ProcessBench轨迹，将任务保持字节一致，对比完整审计-修复对话与长度匹配的非审计控制，进行信号检测分析，并手动审计50个误报。
AI.result: 审计-修复对话使误报率降低2.8-11.5个百分点（相对降幅9-25%），15/15组合有效；阈值移动在15/15组合中出现，13个在修正后仍显著，而d'无显著变化；推理启用时效果保持，人工审计显示82%的误报为明显错误。
AI.conclusion: 先前的审计-修复经历能降低误报，主要通过调整判断阈值而非提升判别力，且这种调整在当前操作点下不会带来危害。

title: Counterfactual Sensitivity Is Not Repairability: Auditing Replay Probes for Video Evidence
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CARVE
summary: Tool-using video agents retrieve visual evidence before answering, but the final answer is not forced to depend on what was retrieved. The natural black box test is counterfactual: destroy the semantic content of the frames the agent retrieved and check whether the answer changes, against a matched sham that re-executes the identical pipeline on those same frames. We introduce CARVE, a black-box counterfactual probe that compares answer changes under matched SHAM and DESTROY replays. Across three independent k=3 runs on a frozen VideoExplorer-style agent, DESTROY changes the answer 29.3 percentage points more often than SHAM, yielding a large and reproducible aggregate effect. Question-level scores are less stable, and increasing the replay budget from k=3 to k=10 reduces ties but weakens the original zero-threshold routing policy. At k=3, CARVE selects 538 of 1,258 LVBench questions and improves accuracy by 3.26 points, with higher fallback yield than most matched random subsets. The score shows only a weak association with annotated temporal coverage, so CARVE is best understood as a routing signal rather than a direct grounding classifier. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CARVE.

AI.tldr: 我们提出了CARVE，一种黑盒反事实探测方法，通过对比SHAM和DESTROY重放下的答案变化，评估视频智能体是否真正依赖检索到的视觉证据。在冻结的VideoExplorer式智能体上，DESTROY比SHAM多改变29.3个百分点的答案，且CARVE选出的538个问题提升了3.26点准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用的视频智能体虽会检索视觉证据，但最终答案未必依赖于检索内容，缺乏直接的黑盒测试方法。
AI.method: CARVE通过反事实干预：在匹配的SHAM（重放相同帧但语义完整）和DESTROY（破坏帧语义）条件下重放相同管道，比较答案变化频率，并计算逐问题得分。
AI.result: 在k=3时，DESTROY改变答案的频率比SHAM高29.3个百分点；CARVE选择538个LVBench问题，准确率提升3.26点，且高于多数随机子集。k=10时连结减少但弱化路由策略，得分与注释时间覆盖度弱相关。
AI.conclusion: CARVE更适合作为路由信号而非直接接地分类器，能有效识别依赖检索证据的问题并提升准确率。

title: Training-Free Long-Term Multi-Object Tracking for Sports Video Analytics
summary: Long-term multi-object tracking in sports remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, rapid camera motion, and repeated player reappearances. We introduce McByte++, a training-free tracking-by-detection framework that integrates lightweight mask propagation, conditional camera motion compensation, and online re-identification within a unified pipeline. Compared to its predecessor, McByte++ substantially improves runtime efficiency while enhancing identity preservation. On SoccerNet-tracking and SportsMOT benchmarks, McByte++ achieves up to +3.0 HOTA and +6.1 IDF1 improvements over the original McByte in the online setting, with further gains when combined with offline global association. Replacing heavy segmentation components and optimizing motion modeling yields up to an order-of-magnitude speed increase. All results are obtained without detector retraining or dataset-specific tuning. Code will be made available at https://github.com/tstanczyk95/McBytePlusPlus.

AI.tldr: McByte++ 是一个训练免费的多目标跟踪框架，通过轻量级掩码传播、条件相机运动补偿和在线重识别，显著提高了体育场景中的跟踪效率和身份保持能力。
AI.motivation: 体育场景中的长期多目标跟踪因遮挡、快速相机运动和球员重复出现而具有挑战性，现有方法在效率和身份保持方面存在不足。
AI.method: 采用训练免费的跟踪-by-检测框架，集成轻量级掩码传播、条件相机运动补偿和在线重识别，并可选结合离线全局关联。
AI.result: 在 SoccerNet-tracking 和 SportsMOT 基准上，在线设置下 HOTA 提升最多 +3.0，IDF1 提升最多 +6.1，且速度提升高达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: McByte++ 在无需检测器重训练或数据集特定调整的情况下，实现了性能提升和效率优化，代码已公开。

title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies
summary: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reconstruction 基准，仅凭论文发表前的参考文献来恢复其核心研究想法，并验证了多智能体流水线能显著提升匹配率。
AI.motivation: 探索语言模型是否能从有限信息（仅参考文献）中重构出论文的真实研究想法，同时防范数据泄漏。
AI.method: 构建 Reconstruction 基准，采用严格防泄漏协议（时间截断、匿名引用ID、固定参考文献），并通过独立LLM评判匹配度；提出参考-only多智能体流水线（跨模型评审+瑞士锦标赛选择）。
AI.result: 七个前沿模型单项匹配率仅3-15%；多智能体流水线将匹配率提升至23-42%，约为最佳单模型基线的2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭参考文献恢复研究想法具有挑战，但多智能体协作可显著提升效果，且防泄漏设计保证评估可信度。

title: Measuring Reward Hacking and Reasoning-Answer Decoupling Under Position-Confounded Optimization
comment: Accepted at the AI Measurement Science Workshop, COLM 2026
summary: When a reward is correct on every training example yet consistent with more than one goal, a model can acquire an unintended one, a failure known as goal misgeneralization. Endpoint accuracy on the training distribution cannot tell the two apart, because solving the task and exploiting a surface feature can satisfy the reward equally well. We treat this as a measurement problem: what does a benchmark score measure once a model has been optimized against a correct but confounded signal? We train language models with GRPO on multiple-choice math problems where the correct answer is always option A, then evaluate on an unseen test set with unbiased answer positions. Across Qwen2.5, Llama 3.x and Gemma-3 models, biased training often drives option-A rates above 0.90 in smaller models and collapses unbiased accuracy toward chance, so accuracy stops measuring math ability and instead measures an answer-position policy. We further find reasoning-answer decoupling: capable models generate reasoning that reaches the correct numeric answer while still selecting A. We track this with numeric extraction and an LLM judge (GPT-4.1-mini; Qwen2.5-3B decoupling rate is about 0.66). The broken construct generalizes beyond the training domain: biased models inflate A-rates on out-of-domain MMLU and value-laden prompts. Continued training on unbiased data reverses the in-domain shift unevenly and only partially reverses the out-of-domain one, so a model can appear restored on its training distribution while remaining biased on unseen inputs. Reasoning-answer decoupling rate, together with answer distributions and out-of-domain behavior, separates capability loss from a learned, transferable shortcut.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在奖励信号正确但存在混淆（如答案位置固定）时，模型会学习到非预期目标（目标泛化失败），导致基准分数无法真实反映能力，并提出推理-答案解耦率等指标来区分能力损失与捷径学习。
AI.motivation: 标准训练准确率无法区分模型是否真正解决了任务还是利用了表面特征（如固定答案位置），导致目标泛化失败。
AI.method: 使用GRPO在选择题（正确答案总为A）上训练语言模型，然后在答案位置无偏的测试集上评估；通过数值提取和LLM评判（GPT-4.1-mini）跟踪推理与答案选择是否解耦；并测试领域内和领域外的行为。
AI.result: 有偏训练导致小模型选择A的比例超过0.90，无偏准确率降至随机水平；能力强的模型推理正确但选择A（解耦率约0.66）；有偏模型在领域外（MMLU、价值相关提示）也表现出A偏好；继续无偏训练只能部分逆转领域外偏差。
AI.conclusion: 推理-答案解耦率结合答案分布和领域外行为，能有效区分能力损失与可迁移的捷径；恢复训练可能掩盖未消除的偏差。

title: Mental Model Management: An Operator-Based Framework for LLM Memory
summary: Large language models process large amounts of information but usually lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining compact and evolving conceptual representations. We introduce Mental Model Management (3M), a framework in which knowledge is represented as mental models consisting of compact chunks. Rather than accumulating text passages, 3M continuously integrates new information into an existing conceptual representation. A set of operators extracts knowledge, retrieves relevant models, adds and updates chunks, reorganizes representations, detects inconsistencies, and derives new knowledge. We describe the main 3M operators and illustrate each operation using Evolution Strategies as a running example.

AI.tldr: 提出Mental Model Management (3M)框架，用紧凑知识块表示概念，并通过操作符持续整合新信息，实现知识的动态更新与推理。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型处理大量信息但缺乏显式机制来维护紧凑且不断演进的概念表示，导致知识积累碎片化。
AI.method: 3M框架定义一组操作符，包括知识提取、模型检索、块添加/更新、表示重组、不一致检测和新知识推导，并以Evolution Strategies为例说明。
AI.result: 通过示例展示了各操作符如何工作，验证了框架的可行性和概念表示的可维护性。
AI.conclusion: 3M提供了一种显式管理概念知识的新方法，有望提升语言模型的知识整合和推理能力。

title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models
summary: Byte-level hierarchical language models (LMs) have recently emerged as a robust alternative to their popular counterparts that use subword tokenization. However, generating one byte at a time remains a bottleneck for inference speed. To address this, we introduce multi-byte prediction (MBP), which generates multiple bytes in parallel, speeding up inference with minimal performance impact and no additional parameters. MBP builds on the popular multi-token prediction (MTP) paradigm with two crucial innovations. First, we introduce a variable-length prediction window that aligns with the latent tokens, or segments, of a hierarchical LM. Second, we implement a novel attention-masking scheme that enables parallel byte prediction without violating causality. We show that multi-byte prediction strikes a Pareto-optimal trade-off across multiple generative tasks, instruction following, question answering, summarization, and machine translation, achieving the best trade-off between performance and inference throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多字节预测（MBP）方法，通过并行生成多个字节加速字节级分层语言模型的推理，同时保持性能并无需额外参数。
AI.motivation: 字节级分层语言模型虽鲁棒，但逐字节生成导致推理速度慢，成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: MBP基于多令牌预测（MTP）范式，引入可变长度预测窗口以对齐分层LM的潜在分段，并设计新颖的注意力掩码方案，实现并行字节预测且不违反因果性。
AI.result: 在多种生成任务（指令跟随、问答、摘要、机器翻译）中，MBP在性能与推理吞吐量之间取得帕累托最优权衡。
AI.conclusion: MBP是一种无需额外参数即可显著加速字节级LM推理的有效方法，在性能和速度间达到最佳平衡。

title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
comment: Paper accepted at 3rd HCV workshop at ECCV 2026. 12 pages main text, 16 pages supp
summary: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种多模态大语言模型与人类在目标导向搜索中的眼动扫描路径，发现模型在决策和目标获取上达到或超过人类水平，但注视过程与人类显著不同，表现为低熵、大幅度和自一致的扫描路径，表明其架构是非序列的，且现有指标无法捕捉这一过程性差异。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究多模态大语言模型在相同注视输入下是否像人类一样进行视觉搜索，以评估其作为人类视觉模型的适用性，并指出注意力对齐分数等指标可能忽略过程性差异。
AI.method: 采用COCO-Search18数据集，将三种通用MLLM与人类眼动扫描路径进行对比，通过逐注视点驱动模型接收人类匹配的中央凹视图，并从目标存在决策、目标获取效率和注视过程三个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 模型在目标检测和获取上优于或等同于人类，但在注视过程上表现出与人类不同的特征，如低熵、大幅度和自一致的扫描路径，且模型间的自一致性高于人类间的相互一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结论是当前MLLM虽然能匹配人类的空间分布和结果，但无法复现人类搜索的时间过程，表明其架构缺乏序列性，现有对齐和显著性指标无法评估此类过程性差异，因此不能用于认证人类般的视觉能力，零样本模型适用于结果和空间问题而非时间过程问题。

title: Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning
comment: PIHF method paper
summary:
Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution.
  Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出策略迭代与人类反馈（PIHF）方法，利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重的执行基础，通过版本化自然语言策略和工具集，结合语言模型评论家与临床专家反馈，在罕见病诊断基准上显著提升Recall@1。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型虽能从指令和示例中适应行为，但难以持续改进。受通用策略迭代的启发，作者希望利用预训练模型作为固定执行基础，通过专家引导的迭代修订提升诊断性能。
AI.method: PIHF方法基于预训练语言模型，采用重复评估-改进结构。语言模型评论家和临床专家审查推理与工具使用轨迹，定位常见失败并形成候选修订；专家可重新解释证据并控制采纳或回滚，最终通过Recall@1和Recall@5验证修订效果。
AI.result: 在累积消融和超罕见病基准上，PIHF策略在多个执行器上提升Recall@1：GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点，差异1.7个百分点，效果跨开源和专有模型稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，使用预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基础，结合专家引导的策略迭代，可有效提升罕见病诊断性能，支持该范式的可行性。

title: Bitstream Action Recognition is Byte Modeling
comment: 10 pages; supplementary material included
summary: Conventional action recognition typically relies on successful pixel decoding of the bitstream. However, bitstream corruption during storage or transmission may cause severe visual artifacts or even decoding failure, posing a significant challenge to reliable action recognition. Bitstream Action Recognition (BAR) aims to overcome the dependency on decoding and the vulnerability to corruption. In this paper, we propose a novel BAR framework, Bitstream Recognition via Anchoring Corrupted Embeddings (BRACE). BRACE is a dual-branch byte-modeling architecture that treats a corrupted bitstream and its intact counterpart as two byte realizations of the same action. This guides the generation of rich and stable representations for robustness to corruption through Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment (IARA). The intact representation serves as a stable anchor, and the corrupted one is aligned to it at the embedding and decision levels under Unreliable-Anchor Suppression (UAS), entirely in representation space and without repairing the bitstream. To address the scarcity of corrupted bitstreams in practice, we introduce the Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator (RBCS), a four-parameter simulator that reproduces bit-flip and byte-loss errors arising in transmission and storage. Building on RBCS, we construct the first large-scale BAR dataset (BAR-D), which comprises the BAR-Stanford40 and BAR-PPMI subsets and spans diverse corruption types and severity levels. Finally, we build a large benchmark on BAR-D involving 14 action recognition methods from the pixel, compressed, and bitstream domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRACE has superior robustness to bitstream corruption than all comparison methods. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed RBCS augmentation and IARA.

AI.tldr: 提出BRACE框架，通过双分支字节建模和完整锚定表示对齐，在不修复比特流的情况下实现鲁棒的比特流动作识别，并构建了大规模基准数据集BAR-D。
AI.motivation: 传统动作识别依赖像素解码，但比特流损坏会导致解码失败或视觉伪影，影响识别可靠性。
AI.method: BRACE采用双分支架构，将损坏和完整比特流视为同一动作的两种字节实现，通过完整锚定表示对齐（IARA）和不可靠锚点抑制（UAS）在表示空间对齐嵌入和决策，并设计RBCS模拟器生成损坏数据以扩充训练。
AI.result: 在BAR-D基准上，BRACE在多种损坏类型和严重程度下均优于14种对比方法，消融实验验证了RBCS增强和IARA的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BRACE为比特流动作识别提供了高效鲁棒方案，无需解码或修复比特流，且RBCS和BAR-D为后续研究奠定基础。

title: RRFC: Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning for Iterative Image-to-Image Generation
summary: Conditional image-to-image generators are single-shot: they map input features to an output in one forward pass and treat it as final, with no opportunity to improve on it. Although trained to produce the best possible result in one step, such a model leaves room for improvement if it can adaptively revise its own output over iterations. We propose Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning (RRFC), a novel feedback-conditioning framework for iterative output refinement that teaches a model to adaptively revise its output by conditioning on a new signal, namely its most recent previous prediction, which is fed back as an auxiliary set of channels alongside the original input. This preserves the generator's core architecture while modifying its conditioning interface and, depending on the model family, its training or inference procedure, so RRFC can be attached to existing generators without redesign. We evaluate RRFC across six baselines spanning adversarial, equilibrium, and diffusion-based models and three paired image-to-image translation tasks. Across 18 architecture-task settings, RRFC yields seven Holm-corrected improvements, seven degradations, and four non-significant changes. The gains concentrate on reconstruction-fidelity and identity settings, while five of the seven degradations fall on the single semantic-layout task, where every model declines. These results indicate that feedback-based refinement helps when its objective overlaps with the evaluated property, and that its gains concentrate on the tasks where that overlap holds.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种反馈条件框架RRFC，通过将模型上次预测结果作为额外输入通道，实现迭代输出细化，在多种生成模型和图像翻译任务上评估，发现其在重建保真度任务上有效，但在语义布局任务上效果不佳。
AI.motivation: 条件图像生成模型通常为单次生成，无法进行迭代改进，研究者希望让模型能够根据自身先前输出进行自适应修正，以提升生成质量。
AI.method: RRFC框架：在原有生成器的基础上，将最近一次预测输出作为额外通道与原始输入拼接，作为新的条件输入，保持核心架构不变，仅修改条件接口和训练/推理过程。
AI.result: 在6个基线模型和3个图像翻译任务上的18个架构-任务组合中，RRFC带来了7次统计显著改进、7次显著退化、4次无显著变化；改进集中在重建保真度和身份保持任务，退化集中在语义布局任务。
AI.conclusion: 反馈式细化仅在目标与评估指标重叠时有效，其收益集中在特定任务类型，对语义布局等任务会导致性能下降，需谨慎应用。

title: Automated Fetal Brain MRI Biometry in Healthy and Pathological Cases
comment: Accepted at the PIPPI Workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Automated biometric analysis of fetal brain MRI enables reproducible, observer-independent quantitative assessment, yet existing methods are often restricted to few measurements or evaluated only on healthy cases. We assemble and evaluate an automated biometric analysis pipeline that localizes 22 anatomical landmarks on NeSVoR-reconstructed 3D volumes and derives 11 clinically relevant measurements spanning supratentorial, ventricular, cerebellar, and midline structures. We compare two landmark localization models, H3DE-Net and SCN, on a heterogeneous cohort of 122 acquisitions (both healthy controls and range pathologies). Localization accuracy was assessed with a linear mixed-effects model, agreement with normative growth trajectories with calibrated centile charts, and diagnostic utility with a decision tree classifying VM severity. H3DE-Net achieved significantly lower localization error than SCN across all landmarks (mean 1.36 mm vs. 3.58 mm in HC and 1.90 mm vs. 4.13 mm in PC; p < 0.001), and outperformed a GA-based regression baseline in 7 of 11 measurements. H3DE-Net measurements yielded higher classification AUC in every diagnostic group, with the clearest advantage in separating healthy controls from VM. Decision tree thresholds for ventricular width fell near the clinical 10 mm and 15 mm cut-offs used to define and grade VM.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并评估了一个基于NeSVoR重建的胎儿脑MRI自动生物测量流水线，包含22个解剖标志点定位和11项临床测量，并在122例异质队列中比较了两种定位模型，结果显示H3DE-Net优于SCN，且自动测量具有诊断价值。
AI.motivation: 现有胎儿脑MRI自动测量方法通常局限于少数指标或仅在健康病例上评估，缺乏在病理异质性队列中的系统验证，难以满足临床对可重复性和全面性的需求。
AI.method: 在NeSVoR重建的三维体数据上，使用两种深度学习模型（H3DE-Net和SCN）定位22个解剖标志点，并据此计算11项测量指标；采用线性混合效应模型评估定位精度，用校准百分位图评估与生长轨迹的一致性，并用决策树分类脑室肥大严重程度以评估诊断效用。
AI.result: H3DE-Net在全部标志点的定位误差显著低于SCN（健康组均值1.36mm vs 3.58mm，病理组1.90mm vs 4.13mm，p<0.001），在11项测量中7项优于基于孕周的回归基线；其测量在各类诊断分组中的AUC均更高，尤其在区分健康对照与脑室肥大方面优势最明显；决策树对脑室宽度阈值接近临床10mm和15mm的界定标准。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自动生物测量流水线结合H3DE-Net在异质队列中实现了准确且具有临床意义的胎儿脑测量，支持其作为可重复的产前评估工具的潜力。

title: A Network-driven Framework for Public Event Forecasting via Dynamic Interaction Network Evolution
summary: Effective public event forecasting is essential for intelligent service systems, enabling proactive risk management, adaptive resource allocation, and timely decision-making. In many real-world scenarios, the evolution of public events is driven by dynamic interactions among participants. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes auto-ibDLM, a network-driven deep learning framework that represents events as dynamic interaction networks and predicts public event evolution through participant growth forecasting. The proposed framework adopts a hybrid representation learning strategy that first represents network evolution using network science-informed structural metrics and subsequently transforms the resulting structural feature vectors into compact and robust latent representations through an auto-learning layer. A GRU-based temporal forecasting module is then employed to capture temporal dependencies and predict future participant growth. Extensive experiments on 13 real-world public event datasets and two publicly available dynamic network datasets demonstrate that auto-ibDLM consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art methods in both forecasting accuracy and generalization capability, achieving over 97% accuracy in public event forecasting. Comprehensive experimental analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid representation learning strategy and demonstrate its representation-level interpretability. These results indicate that auto-ibDLM provides an effective and practical solution for intelligent public event forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出auto-ibDLM，一种网络驱动的深度学习框架，通过动态交互网络和参与者增长预测来预测公共事件演变，在13个真实事件数据集和2个公开动态网络数据集上取得超过97%的准确率，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 公共事件演变由参与者间的动态交互驱动，现有方法未充分利用这一网络结构特性，导致预测精度有限。
AI.method: 采用混合表示学习策略，先用网络科学指标提取结构特征，再通过自学习层转化为紧凑潜在表示，最后用GRU捕捉时间依赖性并预测参与人数增长。
AI.result: 在13个真实事件数据集和2个公开动态网络数据集上，预测准确率超过97%，一致优于现有方法，并验证了混合表示学习的有效性和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: auto-ibDLM为智能公共事件预测提供了一种有效且实用的解决方案，具有高精度和强泛化能力。

title: ConceptFormer: Learning Adaptive Latent Concepts for Query-Document Alignment in Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Visual document retrieval is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, aiming to identify query-relevant pages from document collections where evidence is distributed across text, layout, charts, and visual structures. Recent efforts toward finer-grained supervision primarily rely on textual descriptions or localized visual regions as evidence proxies. However, such supervision signals may either overlook complex visual structures or provide incomplete and inaccurate representations of the underlying evidence. To address these limitations, we propose ConceptFormer, a latent concept representation learning framework for visual document retrieval. ConceptFormer models query-relevant evidence as continuous, query-conditioned latent concepts that explicitly bridge localized visual evidence and semantic relevance, without requiring either textual intermediate representations or direct reliance on raw visual annotations. During training, ConceptFormer employs a strong vision-language model to dynamically determine the number of latent concept tokens and uses these concepts as an intermediate representation to bridge the semantic gap between queries and documents, thereby guiding the learning of the embedding space. Experiments on diverse visual document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ConceptFormer achieves 16.7\% and 22.1\% relative improvements in average NDCG@10 over the strongest visual retrieval baseline and the strongest OCR-based text retrieval baseline, respectively. Further analysis reveals that latent concepts effectively connect localized visual evidence with semantic relevance, enabling the retriever to capture both fine-grained textual cues and complex document-level visual structures while preserving strong retrieval alignment. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/Neuir/ConceptFormer.

AI.tldr: 提出ConceptFormer框架，通过查询条件下的连续潜在概念桥接视觉证据与语义相关性，在视觉文档检索中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度监督方法依赖文本描述或局部视觉区域，可能忽略复杂视觉结构或提供不完整证据表示。
AI.method: ConceptFormer使用强视觉-语言模型动态决定潜在概念令牌数量，并作为中间表示连接查询与文档，指导嵌入空间学习。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，平均NDCG@10相对最强视觉基线和OCR文本基线分别提升16.7%和22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 潜在概念有效连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，提升细粒度文本线索和文档级视觉结构的捕捉能力。

title: PixelControl: Fine-Grained Condition Fidelity in Text-to-Image Diffusion
comment: The project homepage can be found: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/
summary: Controllable text-to-image diffusion models can often follow the global layout of spatial conditions, yet still violate fine-grained structures such as object boundaries, thin contours, and medium/small conditioned regions. This limitation is especially problematic for VAE-based latent diffusion, where spatial compression can weaken high-frequency and low-area condition signals. We propose PixelControl, a pixel-space controllable diffusion framework for fine-grained condition fidelity. Built on a PixelDiT-style backbone, PixelControl avoids the latent bottleneck and introduces two complementary designs. First, Structure-Aware Control Injection derives a condition structure map and uses it to strengthen injected control residuals around spatially sensitive regions. Second, Multi-Scale Pyramid Cycle Loss verifies generated images against condition-derived structures across multiple resolutions, balancing global layout consistency with local boundary and detail accuracy. PixelControl supports depth, segmentation, edge, and their combinations through modality-specific control branches with lightweight gated fusion. Experiments across depth, segmentation, and edge control show that PixelControl improves structural fidelity and visual quality over existing controllable generation methods, with especially strong gains on boundaries and medium/small conditioned regions. The project page can be found at: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/

AI.tldr: 提出PixelControl，一种基于像素空间的可控扩散框架，通过结构感知控制注入和多尺度金字塔循环损失，提高边界和中小区域的条件保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有可控文本到图像扩散模型在全局布局上表现良好，但常违反细粒度结构（如物体边界、细轮廓、中小条件区域），尤其VAE潜扩散中的空间压缩会削弱高频和低区域条件信号。
AI.method: 基于PixelDiT骨干，避免潜在瓶颈，提出结构感知控制注入（利用条件结构图增强敏感区域的控制残差）和多尺度金字塔循环损失（在不同分辨率下验证图像与条件结构的一致性，平衡全局与局部）。
AI.result: 在深度、分割和边缘控制实验中，PixelControl相比现有方法提高了结构保真度和视觉质量，尤其在边界和中小条件区域。
AI.conclusion: PixelControl显着提升了细粒度条件控制能力，支持多种条件及组合，为高保真可控生成提供了新方案。

title: Who Leads Now? Token-Level Modality Arbitration for Chart-to-Code Generation
summary: Chart-to-code generation requires a model to read the fine-grained visual details of a chart and write executable code that reproduces it. Existing chart-to-code methods either train visual and coding abilities separately, or fine-tune on chart-to-code data with the two abilities entangled. Neither strategy accounts for the distinct nature of the two abilities or the interference that arises when they are optimized together. We propose MoCA (Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration), which separates the two abilities rather than blending them. MoCA is built on Cross-modal Arbitration Block (CAB), which maintains a visual branch and a code branch as two distinct pathways, and a lightweight arbiter that arbitrates their relative contributions at every layer and generated token. We train MoCA in two stages: a supervised warm-up on self-distilled reasoning trajectories that decomposes visual understanding into explicit steps, followed by reinforcement learning with rewards on both the reasoning process and the final code. Analysis shows that the arbiter learns structured rather than arbitrary allocations, with expert contributions varying systematically across tokens, layers, and instances. Across three benchmarks, MoCA delivers competitive performance against general-domain and chart-specialized models. Ablation results show that the gains cannot be attributed to a larger model size alone, but instead arise from the joint contributions of complementary visual and code branch initialization and input-conditioned arbitration through CAB.

AI.tldr: 提出MoCA模型，通过分离视觉理解和代码生成两种能力，利用跨模态仲裁块和两阶段训练，在图表转代码任务上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有图表转代码方法要么分开训练视觉和编码能力，要么在图表转代码数据上联合微调，未考虑两种能力的差异性及联合优化时的干扰。
AI.method: MoCA基于跨模态仲裁块（CAB），包含视觉分支和代码分支两个独立路径，以及轻量仲裁器在每层和每个生成token上分配贡献。训练分两阶段：先在自蒸馏推理轨迹上进行监督预热，再使用强化学习优化推理过程和最终代码的奖励。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，MoCA表现与通用和图表专用模型相当。消融实验表明性能提升不仅源于模型规模，还来自视觉和代码分支的互补初始化及CAB的输入条件仲裁。
AI.conclusion: 分离视觉与代码能力并动态仲裁其贡献，能有效提高图表转代码的性能，且仲裁器学到的分配是结构化而非任意的。

title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search
summary: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions, and control flow. This freedom enlarges the search space, risking invalid candidates and premature convergence to one design region. ATLAS independently detects execution, interface, and feasibility failures, recomputes objectives, and applies error-conditioned repair; similarity-based archive management preserves algorithms across embedding-space regions to counter premature convergence. Its three-layer search refines the best design, gives other regions dedicated refinement opportunities, and performs cross-region synthesis to recombine components and their interactions. Across four NP-hard problems, ATLAS outperforms several state-of-the-art component-synthesis methods and a matched full-synthesis baseline while remaining competitive with strong human-designed algorithms. One ATLAS run retains several algorithms with comparable performance from distinct embedding-space regions rather than a single design. Code inspection finds that these multi-component designs differ in their primary construction or global-search backbone. Our results suggest that embedding-guided quality-diversity search can make the enlarged full-algorithm design space practically searchable. Source code and exact executable prompts are available at <https://github.com/Danial-Yazdani/ATLAS>.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个基于嵌入引导的质量多样性框架，用于组合优化中无脚手架的全算法合成，通过错误条件修复和相似性归档管理，在四个NP困难问题上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自动化算法设计方法局限于人类指定的组件和交互，无法探索更大设计空间。
AI.method: ATLAS框架结合嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索、独立错误检测与修复、相似性归档管理和三层搜索（局部优化、区域细化、跨区域合成）。
AI.result: 在四个NP困难问题上，ATLAS优于多种组件合成方法和全合成基线，与强人工设计算法竞争，并能保留多区域多样性算法。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索使全算法设计空间变得实际可搜索，为自动化算法设计提供了新方向。

title: What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA
comment: Accepted at ECCV2026. Code: https://github.com/jinhseo/GroundFormer. Project page: https://jinhseo.github.io/groundformer/groundformer.html
summary: We study a critical yet overlooked failure mode in Grounded Video Question Answering: question-invariant grounding, where models predict nearly identical temporal segments for different questions about the same video. We trace this behavior to two structural limitations in prior common designs: (i) modality isolation that fixes video representations before they receive question semantics, and (ii) weak question injection inside the grounding module. To address this, we propose GroundFormer, which conditions video features on question intent before localization via learnable communication tokens that mediate directed visuo-lingual interaction. On top of the question-conditioned features, a factorized MIL cross-attention couples answer selection with temporal evidence under candidate-level supervision, while Gaussian smoothing converts peaked attention into temporally coherent segments. We further introduce a hierarchical multi-modal contrastive loss that aligns video, question, and answer embeddings across a two-pass training pipeline. GroundFormer achieves state-of-the-art grounded VideoQA performance on NExT-GQA and STAR, substantially improving question-discriminative temporal grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文发现并解决Grounded VideoQA中问题不变定位的问题，提出GroundFormer模型，通过可学习通信令牌在定位前融合问题语义，实现视频-问题交互，显著提升时序定位的判别性。
AI.motivation: 现有Grounded VideoQA模型存在一个关键缺陷：对于同一视频的不同问题，模型预测出几乎相同的时序片段，即问题不变定位。此问题源于两个结构限制：模态隔离（视频特征固定，未接收问题语义）和接地模块内弱问题注入。
AI.method: 提出GroundFormer：1）使用可学习通信令牌在定位前调节视频特征，实现视频与问题的定向交互；2）基于问题条件特征，利用因子化MIL交叉注意力耦合答案选择与时间证据，并在候选级监督下进行；3）采用高斯平滑将峰值注意力转换为时间连贯片段；4）提出层次多模态对比损失，在两阶段训练中对齐视频、问题和答案嵌入。
AI.result: 在NExT-GQA和STAR基准上达到最先进性能，显著提升问题判别性的时间接地效果。
AI.conclusion: GroundFormer通过问题条件化视频特征和细粒度监督，有效缓解问题不变定位问题，提高了Grounded VideoQA的准确性和时序定位的判别性，为该领域提供了新思路。

title: From Contexts to Values: Context-Dependent Defeat in Abstract Argumentation
comment: Accepted to SAFA workshop at COMMA 2026
summary: In value-based argumentation, an audience's ordering of values decides which attacks succeed as defeats. In many settings the deciding factor is not the audience but the circumstances: the same attack may succeed at one procedural stage, or under one regulation, and fail at another. Context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), a model we recently introduced, capture this directly: one set of arguments, one attack relation, and a defeat function that switches each attack on or off per context, so every context induces an ordinary Dung framework. This raises a reduction question: is context genuinely new, or can one value assignment with per-context orderings reproduce the defeat function, collapsing the CDAF into a VAF? We present a polynomial-time decision procedure for this question and map the harder neighbouring problems, with upper bounds from NP to $Σ^p_3$. We also present a validated reference implementation and a measurement: representability is rare and falls fast with the number of contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了上下文依赖论证框架（CDAFs）是否可以被价值观论证框架（VAFs）等价替代，提出了一种多项式时间判定算法，并证明了在更多上下文下可表示性迅速降低。
AI.motivation: 在价值论证中，攻击是否成功取决于受众的价值观排序，但在实际场景中，决定因素往往是环境或上下文（如程序阶段、法规等）。作者此前提出CDAF模型直接捕捉这种情境依赖性，但一个关键问题是：CDAF是否真的引入了新的表达能力，还是可以归约为VAF（即通过每个上下文的价值观排序重现击败函数）。
AI.method: 提出了一个多项式时间的判定过程来检验CDAF是否可归约为VAF，并分析了相关更困难问题的复杂度边界（从NP到Σ^p_3），同时提供了经过验证的参考实现。
AI.result: 多项式时间判定算法可以解决可归约性问题；相关变体问题复杂度更高（NP至Σ^p_3）；实验测量表明，随着上下文数量增加，可表示性（即CDAF可归约为VAF）非常罕见且快速下降。
AI.conclusion: CDAF在表达能力上通常优于VAF，并非所有情境依赖的论证框架都能用价值观排序模拟，因此CDAF是一种有实质意义的新模型。

title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
comment: Code and data are available at \url{https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR}
summary: Experience-learning agents for optimization modeling improve by storing verified skills, but existing learners admit knowledge by checking against known answers, which real ticket streams do not provide. The natural label-free alternatives are unreliable: on a 300-problem label-blind stream, admitting every executable model poisons roughly one admission in four, while single-instance agreement accepts models that match at one value but differ elsewhere. We propose AdmitOR, an admission gate built on calibrated external behavioral evidence. Candidates from three model families, prompting strategies, and solver stacks are run on instances resampled from an extracted parameter domain; agreement across the resulting value-function traces is summarized by a cross-family clique, and a calibrated threshold returns accept, abstain, or escalate. The preregistered false-discovery criterion holds on calibration data but not on the wild stream. We report this negative result in full and trace most failures to benchmark texts that do not faithfully encode their labeled instances. Comparing four admission judges on one collection of logs inside a state-of-the-art skill learner, AdmitOR raises admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote and 0.726 for execution success, yielding 3.1x and 8.0x fewer poisoned admissions. Its library is the smallest and attains the highest macro accuracy across five public benchmarks, 58.4 against 54.8 for majority vote and 53.9 for the ground-truth-labeled library. The 3.5-point gain over majority vote is supported by a paired bootstrap and survives correction for a host-side anomaly. To our knowledge, AdmitOR is the first label-free admission mechanism designed around an explicitly calibrated false-discovery target. The transfer failure identifies a necessary condition for extending it to wild streams.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于校准外部行为证据的无标签准入机制AdmitOR，用于优化建模中的技能学习，提高了准入精度并减少了污染，但在实际数据流上存在迁移失败。
AI.motivation: 现有的经验学习智能体依赖已知答案验证技能，而真实工单流不提供标签；无标签替代方法不可靠，需要校准的准入机制。
AI.method: AdmitOR从提取的参数域重采样实例，运行多个模型家族的候选，通过跨家族团汇总值函数轨迹的一致性，并用校准阈值决定接受、弃权或升级。
AI.result: 在标准技能学习器中，AdmitOR将准入精度提升至0.927，优于多数投票的0.871和执行成功的0.726；库最小且宏精度最高（58.4），但预注册的假发现率在真实流上未达标。
AI.conclusion: AdmitOR是首个针对校准假发现目标的无标签准入机制，但迁移失败表明扩展至真实流需要基准文本忠实编码实例标签等条件。

title: Anatomical and Physical Supervision for CT-less PET Attenuation Correction: BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge
comment: 6 pages, 1 table. Technical report for the BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge
